jobs.title: Project Manager (Oncology)
jobs.description:
Clinical Project Manager (Oncology)- United States or Canada- Remote

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.

If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

Do you want to watch clinical development change, or do you want to be the one to shape it?

Because we’re hoping you’re here for the latter.

Who Are You?

You are a natural leader with a passion for drug development. You are organized, but flexible and adaptable to unexpected changes. You can easily envision the bigger picture, without losing sight of the day-to-day tasks. You provide excellent leadership not only to your project teams, but also to clients. You are excited and enthusiastic, motivating your teams to do great work and collaborating easily with your clients. You never settle for what is but are always pushing clinical development forward to what it can be, while encouraging others to do the same. Most of all, you want to do this work in a place where you’re more than an employee number – a place where you can influence, innovate and be afforded opportunities for growth. A place you love working.

Still here? Good. Because if this is you, we’d really like to meet you.

What will you be doing?

Long story short, you oversee the whole project or a portfolio of projects. As a Project Manager, you will be the primary liaison to your clients, ensuring questions are answered and issues are resolved. You work together with other project leaders and vendors to keep your projects running at optimal quality - on time and on budget - managing all project deliverables, with financial acumen and a risk mitigation mindset. As a project leader, you provide feedback to your team to help improve overall performance.

Job Responsibilities

Act as primary liaison with clients.
Lead and direct cross-functional team leaders and third parties/vendors with some supervision and support.
Manage project contractual deliverables, including progress via metrics and adherence to contractual agreement time, quality/scope, and cost deliverables).
Participation and attendance in bid defense process.
Provide feedback on project team members’ performance to respective line-managers.
Maintain detailed understanding of each functional service area and lead multifaceted functional teams effectively with little supervision or support.
Develop in depth analysis and projections of project timelines and financials for senior and customer management with little to no supervision.

What do you need to have?

Minimum of 3 years’ experience in clinical research within a CRO
Undergraduate degree or its international equivalent from an accredited institution or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the key responsibilities of this job, required
Undergraduate degree in clinical, science, or health-related field, preferred
Licensed healthcare professional (i.e., registered nurse), preferred

Minimum 1-2 years of experience leading Oncology cellular therapy clinical trials, strongly preferred.
English fluency (ability to read, write, speak), required
Travel of up to 25% is required for this position. Exact amounts of travel will vary, pending client needs.
To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

Benefits Of Working In ICON

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

We offer very competitive salary packages. And to keep them competitive, we regularly benchmark them against our competitors. Our annual bonuses reflect delivery of performance goals – both ours and yours.

We also provide a range of health-related benefits to employees and their families and offer competitive retirement plans – and related benefits such as life assurance – so you can save and plan with confidence for the years ahead.

But beyond the competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, you’ll benefit from an environment where you are encouraged to fulfil your sense of purpose and drive lasting change.

ICON is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here

Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.

jobs.title: Product Development Project Manager – Consumer Products
jobs.location: Quezon City, National Capital Region, Philippines
jobs.description:
Keep every product on time, on budget, and on everyone's radar, from first concept to launch.

We're looking for a product-focused Project Manager to keep product development organized for a consumer products e-commerce business. You'll own costing, pricing, timelines, and project plans. You'll also be the bridge between our China-based product team and Sales, so everyone knows where each product stands and when it's coming. This is a product development role, not a software, IT, or factory operations role.

Location:

Philippines - Fully Remote

Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

Own and maintain the product cost calculator, including materials, manufacturing, packaging, freight, and landed costs.

Build and update pricing models to support margin targets and sales decisions.

Create and manage product development timelines and Gantt charts across multiple projects.

Coordinate daily with the China team to track samples, approvals, revisions, and production milestones.

Keep Sales updated on product status, launch dates, costs, and changes.

Flag delays, cost changes, and risks early, and propose solutions.

Organize project documentation, trackers, and status reports.

Run regular check-ins to keep stakeholders aligned and decisions moving.

Improve processes and tools so product development runs smoothly as the portfolio grows.

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

Project management experience in consumer product development, ideally physical goods sold through retail or e-commerce.

Experience managing product timelines from concept through sampling, production, and launch.

Strong understanding of product costing, pricing, and margins.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills: you're comfortable building and maintaining cost models.

Experience building Gantt charts and project plans (Smartsheet, Monday, Asana, MS Project, or similar).

Experience working with overseas suppliers or manufacturing teams, especially in China, is a strong plus.

Excellent written and verbal communication; you keep busy teams informed without being asked.

Highly organized and comfortable juggling many products at different stages.

Background in software, IT, or localization project management alone is not a fit for this role.

Why Adaptive Teams?

At Adaptive Teams, we don’t just fill positions – we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. If you’re looking for exciting opportunities and, a team that’s as passionate as you are, this is the place to be.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager- Pharmacy Operations
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager, Pharmacy Operations
(Remote)
Location:
Remote (US) ·
Type:
Full-time ·
Reports to:
Pharmacy/Platform Operations Manager ·
Direct report:
Pharmacy & Fulfillment Coordinator · Pay: $100,000–$130,000

About Company

The company is a physician-guided weight loss company delivering care through telehealth. Every patient's experience depends on prescriptions moving cleanly from provider to pharmacy to doorstep, and on the systems that connect them.

The role

You'll run the projects that keep our pharmacy operations running and improving: pharmacy partner onboarding, EMR and pharmacy integrations, and workflow changes that touch our providers, pharmacies and patients. The Pharmacy/Platform Operations Manager sets the priorities; you turn them into plans, keep timelines real and get them to go-live.
You'll also lead our Pharmacy & Fulfillment Coordinator, who handles the daily order exceptions,
pharmacy follow-ups and shipping issues. What they see day to day feeds the fixes you drive, and the processes you launch become the work they run.
What you'll do

Run pharmacy and platform projects
• Plan and run cross-functional projects across operations, pharmacy partners, clinical, product
and engineering, from kickoff to go-live
• Lead pharmacy partner onboarding and changes: e-prescribing setup, order routing, fulfillment
and shipping workflows, and SLAs
• Run EMR-related projects, including configuration changes, integrations with pharmacy and
order systems, and data flows between them
• Build project plans, timelines and risk logs, bring scope, timeline and go-live decisions to the
Pharmacy/Platform Operations Manager

• Write plain-language status updates the Ops Manager can share with leadership
Improve fulfillment workflows
• Map current workflows and find bottlenecks in prescription turnaround and fulfillment
• Use the Coordinator'd exception and escalation data to spot recurring issues and drive fixes to
completion
• Track project impact on turnaround time, fulfillment accuracy and order exceptions
Lead the Pharmacy & Fulfillment Coordinator

• Hire, train and coach the Coordinator; set daily priorities and review their work
• Own the Coordinator's playbook: order exception handling, pharmacy follow-ups, shipping
issues and escalation paths
• Be the escalation point for issues the Coordinator can't resolve, and raise systemic ones to the
Ops Manager
Launch it right

• Make sure projects meet HIPAA, PHI handling and state pharmacy and telehealth requirements,
working with compliance
• Write SOPs and train the Coordinator and support teams when new processes launch
What you bring

• 4+ years of project management experience, with 2+ years in pharmacy operations (mail-order,
specialty, compounding or retail)
• 1+ year supervising or mentoring at least one team member, or leading day-to-day work of
coordinators or specialists
• Hands-on experience with EMR systems and pharmacy integrations (e-prescribing, order
management, fulfillment platforms)
• Track record delivering cross-functional projects with outside partners and vendors
• Working knowledge of HIPAA and pharmacy regulatory requirements
• Strong with project tools (e.g., Monday.com, Asana, Jira, Smartsheet)
• Organized, direct communicator who follows through
Nice to have

• Telehealth or DTC healthcare experience, especially weight management or GLP-1 programs
• Pharmacy background
• PMP or similar project management certification
What we offer

• 5 days paid time off
• 5 days paid sick leave
• 6 paid federal holidays
• Fully remote with a mission-driven team

jobs.title: Information Technology Program Manager
jobs.description:
RBox International Solutions, Inc. is a Philippines-based organization providing business and operational support services. We are currently hiring for a Senior IT Program Manager or Senior IT Project Manager
to support enterprise technology initiatives and collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Work Arrangement:
Full-time | Permanent Night Shift (9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT) | Work From Home

Position Overview

The Senior Program Manager
leads a portfolio of concurrent technology projects across software engineering, ERP, CRM, system integration, and compliance. This role translates business priorities into delivery plans, manages dependencies across teams and vendors, and reports progress and risks directly to executive leadership.
The Senior Program Manager sets delivery standards for the team, coaches Technical Project Managers, strengthens PMO practices, and helps establish a developing PMO. This is a fully remote position reporting to U.S.-based IT leadership, with a fixed night shift aligned with U.S. business hours.
Responsibilities
Portfolio Delivery:
Lead multiple concurrent technology projects, manage cross-team dependencies, and deliver committed outcomes on time and within scope.
Planning and Estimation:
Ensure documented project plans are established in Azure DevOps (ADO) before development begins. Review estimates, balance team capacity, and recommend project sequencing when priorities compete.
Executive Reporting:
Prepare weekly executive status reports and quarterly business reviews. Provide evidence-based RAG ratings, highlight business impact, and identify decisions requiring leadership attention.
Intake and Scope Control:
Manage incoming requests and changing priorities. Evaluate tradeoffs, implement change control, and communicate recommendations with clear alternatives.
Risk and Escalation:
Proactively identify portfolio risks, escalate concerns with actionable recommendations, and drive timely resolution.
Vendor and Partner Management:
Oversee delivery vendors and implementation partners, including statements of work (SOWs), milestones, acceptance criteria, and performance management.
Requirements and Solution Alignment:
Collaborate with business owners, business systems analysts, and engineering teams to define business requirements, align solutions, and establish acceptance and launch criteria.
Delivery Metrics:
Define and monitor delivery KPIs using ADO data, including on-time delivery, scope changes, carryover, and cycle time.
Regulated Delivery:
Incorporate regulatory and compliance requirements, including SOC 2 and applicable industry standards, into project plans, change control, documentation, and audit processes.
Coaching and PMO Standards:
Mentor Technical Project Managers in planning, ADO practices, and reporting. Improve PMO templates, intake processes, and performance metrics.
Automation and AI:
Drive automation initiatives for recurring PMO activities, including AI-assisted status reporting and dashboards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 6 years of project management experience in IT, software, or technology, including 3 years managing multiple concurrent projects or cross-functional programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise technology projects, including ERP, CRM, or system integrations.
Advanced proficiency in Azure DevOps or Jira, including portfolio backlogs, queries, and dashboards.
Experience presenting project updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Experience managing vendors, SOWs, milestones, and project acceptance.
Experience coaching or mentoring project managers.
Hands-on experience in project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
Willingness to work a fixed night shift, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time, with at least 12 months of continuous prior night shift experience.
Reliable home internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet, and a dedicated private workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or PgMP certification, along with PSM or SAFe certification.
Experience delivering ERP, CRM, EDI, or data platform programs.
Experience working in regulated industries, including pharmaceutical distribution, or with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and DSCSA.
Experience developing Power BI dashboards using ADO data.
Experience establishing or improving PMO practices, including project intake, templates, governance, and KPIs.
Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for project management, reporting, and automation.

Why Join Us?

Help shape and strengthen a developing Project Management Office.
Collaborate directly with U.S.-based IT leadership and gain exposure to executive stakeholders.
Manage a diverse portfolio of enterprise technology, integration, and compliance initiatives.
Explore professional growth opportunities toward PMO leadership.
Work with modern project management, analytics, and AI-assisted reporting tools.
Enjoy a fully remote work arrangement.

This organization operates within the technology solutions sector, focusing on addressing the challenges businesses face in the digital transformation era. It delivers a variety of technology projects, including full-stack development, hyperautomation, cloud data analytics, and large language model-based generative AI, through a team of project managers, consultants, and software and data architects.

The TECHNICAL PROJECT MANAGER role is a mid-senior level, full-time remote position that bridges consulting and project management. The position serves as the main contact for clients, guiding them throughout the software development lifecycle from requirements gathering to final delivery, ensuring alignment with client needs and project goals.

Collaborate with clients to translate business needs into technical requirements.
Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation using a project management system.
Lead cross-functional teams to deliver solutions on time and within budget.
Ensure adherence to established working principles including Lean UX and architectural clarity.
Communicate project progress and risks to clients and stakeholders.
Manage client expectations to maintain satisfaction.
Contribute to improving processes and methodologies.
Perform enterprise data modeling to support business processes and reporting.

Over 5 years of experience in technical project management, engineering management, or technical product ownership with successful project delivery.
Strong knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Lean UX.
Experience with cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure and AWS.
Familiarity with data warehousing, hyperautomation, and AI/ML is advantageous.

We are a business to business support service for independent mental healthcare practitioners, which helps providers service a growing client base. The Facilities Project Manager leads the planning, design, construction, buildout, launch, and closeout of new therapy office locations and major facilities projects. Work is performed remotely with travel to offsite venues, such as active construction sites and offices, as needed. Process Improvement & Documentation

Continuously improve project processes, tools, and documentation to support organizational growth and scalability.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A Little More About Your Role…

We are looking for Delivery Leads, (Project Managers/Directors and Assistant Project Managers), to manage high-value, challenging projects and programmes within the Defence and Security sector. In this role, you will report to the Senior Delivery Lead and be responsible for delivering projects according to the project plan. Assistant Project Managers will either support larger projects and programmes or take the lead on smaller projects as Project Managers.

We are looking for proactive individuals who can build strong relationships with clients and internal teams to get tasks scoped and delivered to budget, on time and in line with client expectations and the WSP Business Management System. This is a hands-on role that will see you chairing meetings, writing reports, organising resources and monitoring finances.
You will be responsible for traditional project management activities including but not limited to scope and resource management, finance and schedule monitoring, change control, risk management and client management, overlaid with additional requirements of the Defence and Security sector such as security management.
As a growing and diverse team, tackling complex infrastructure projects that span the RIBA design stages.

We are relatively new to the sector and are recruiting following several significant wins with both public and private sector clients. As well as delighting our growing client base we are developing a strong defence and security culture within WSP. In this role you will be expected to support ongoing work winning activities and act as an ambassador for the sector within the business.

We are nationwide and work flexibly between home, WSP and client offices, travelling as required to best deliver the particular needs of the project/programme.

What We Would Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Proven experience in the Defence and Security sector in a project/programme management capacity delivering construction or infrastructure projects (not IT Infrastructure) including a demonstrable understanding of working in accordance with security protocols
Knowledge of any of the following:
MOD policy, processes and procedures
Knowledge of the JSPs, in particular JSP 850
The Green Book and 5 case model for business cases

An existing network within the Defence and Security sector
Degree in relevant technical discipline (engineering, building, quantity surveying, science, project or construction management)
Recognised project or programme management qualification from one of the following: PMI, APM, RICS, CIOB
NEC3/4 PM qualification

You must be eligible to achieve Security Clearance.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

Requirements

The successful candidate will serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects and will coordinate multidisciplinary engineering, project controls, procurement, construction, testing, operations, maintenance, quality, and client stakeholders. The role requires strong project leadership, disciplined execution, and the ability to deliver work safely, accurately, and in accordance with applicable station, client, regulatory, and quality requirements. As a Project Manager, you will:

Lead assigned nuclear projects through planning, engineering, procurement, implementation, testing, turnover, and closeout.
Establish and maintain project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, execution strategies, and performance objectives.
Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams and maintain alignment among engineering, construction, operations, maintenance, testing, procurement, quality, and project-controls organizations.
Serve as the primary client and station point of contact for project matters.
Develop and maintain project work plans, integrated schedules, milestone plans, risk registers, action-item logs, decision logs, and status reports.
Monitor project cost, schedule, resource loading, commitments, forecasts, changes, and performance trends.
Lead project meetings, readiness reviews, design reviews, planning sessions, walkdowns, and execution coordination meetings.
Identify project risks, constraints, interfaces, and emerging issues; develop mitigation strategies and escalate matters when appropriate.
Manage scope development and change control, including evaluation of impacts to cost, schedule, quality, safety, configuration, and implementation readiness.
Coordinate vendor, contractor, and supplier interfaces, including technical deliverables, procurement activities, field support, and performance follow-up.
Support work-order development, outage planning, construction planning, startup, testing, turnover, and closeout activities as applicable to the assigned project.
Ensure project deliverables are complete, technically accurate, properly reviewed, and issued in accordance with client and Sargent & Lundy requirements.
Promote nuclear safety, quality assurance, configuration control, human performance, and procedural adherence throughout project execution.
Maintain effective communication with station leadership, client project managers, responsible engineers, discipline leads, suppliers, contractors, and field personnel.
Support lessons learned, continuous improvement, and knowledge transfer across project teams.

Work Environment

This position is based on a hybrid work schedule supporting Brunswick Nuclear Station in Southport, NC and will require on-site support 2-4 days a week. The role may require occasional travel to Sargent & Lundy offices, client locations, vendor facilities, or other project sites. Additional hours or outage-period support may be required based on project and station needs.

Qualifications

E Ssential Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, project management, business, or a related technical field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
10 or more years of applicable experience in nuclear power, utility, engineering, construction, project management, or a related technical environment.

jobs.description:
Client-Side Project Manager - ADP Lyric

About enhanceHCM

enhanceHCM is a national professional services firm specializing in M&A Strategic HCM Consulting, Interim HR and Payroll Support, Project Management, Systems Implementation, and Tax Registration Support across a wide range of industries. Focused on optimizing Human Capital Management, we partner with middle market and Fortune 1000 organizations, private equity firms, and their portfolio companies to deliver high-impact solutions in complex, fast-paced environments.
Our team brings decades of hands-on experience and deep functional expertise to every engagement, with a proven track record of delivering trusted, results-driven outcomes. We are actively seeking experienced professionals with expertise in Strategic HR, Payroll, Project Management, Systems Implementation, and Human Capital M&A. Ideal candidates are relationship-driven, highly organized, and thrive in solving complex business challenges with confidence and precision

The Opportunity

We're looking for a driven, strategic, and detail-oriented Lyric Implementation Project/Program Manager to join our team. In this role, you'll serve as the client-side project leader throughout the end-to-end implementation lifecycle, providing the governance, structure, and leadership necessary to drive successful enterprise HCM implementations.
Acting as an extension of the client's team and a strategic partner to the software vendor, you'll serve as the liaison between both parties, ensuring alignment on project objectives, timelines, deliverables, and measures of success. You'll advocate for the client's business priorities while fostering a collaborative vendor relationship that supports shared accountability, effective decision-making, and successful implementation outcomes.
This role requires more than traditional project coordination. You'll lead project governance, guide cross-functional teams, manage risks and escalations, and bring clarity and direction to complex implementation environments, including those involving API integrations and technical dependencies. Your ability to influence stakeholders, resolve challenges, and maintain momentum will be critical to delivering successful outcomes for both the client and the vendor.
This is a remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced project or program manager who thrives in a dynamic, client-facing environment and brings a strong understanding of enterprise HCM implementations, stakeholder leadership, and vendor-client partnership management.
What You'll Do

Own Project Governance: Establish and lead project governance throughout all phases of the Lyric implementation lifecycle, including project planning, milestones, deliverables, decision-making, risk management, issue resolution, and accountability.
Lead End-to-End Implementations: Provide client-side project leadership from initiation and planning through execution, testing, deployment, go-live, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with established project objectives and success measures.
Serve as the Client's Advocate: Act as an extension of the client's team, representing its business priorities, operational requirements, and strategic objectives while ensuring concerns are addressed and commitments are met.
Partner Strategically with the Vendor: Serve as the primary liaison between the client and software vendor, fostering a collaborative partnership, aligning expectations, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining shared accountability for implementation success.
Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Coordinate and guide client stakeholders, vendor resources, technical teams, and functional subject matter experts across multiple workstreams, ensuring clear ownership, effective collaboration, and timely execution.
Oversee Technical Dependencies and Integrations: Coordinate API integrations, data interfaces, and other technical dependencies within the HCM implementation, partnering with technical teams to identify risks, manage interdependencies, and drive resolution.
Manage Risks, Issues, and Escalations: Proactively identify project risks, remove roadblocks, manage scope and timeline impacts, and lead de-escalation efforts when challenges arise. Facilitate productive conversations that restore alignment and keep projects moving forward.
Drive Stakeholder Communication and Alignment: Establish clear communication channels, facilitate project status meetings and governance forums, communicate project health and risks, and ensure stakeholders have the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.
Monitor Project Performance and Success Measures: Track progress against milestones, scope, budget, deliverables, and agreed-upon success criteria, providing visibility into project performance and driving corrective action when needed.
Build Trusted Client Relationships: Develop strong relationships with client leadership, project teams, and vendor partners through proactive communication, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on client experience and successful outcomes.
Ensure Mutual Project Success: Balance client advocacy with a collaborative vendor partnership, ensuring the implementation delivers meaningful business value for the client while supporting a productive, successful engagement for all parties.

What You Bring

Proven experience leading enterprise-level HCM software implementations, preferably with hands-on project or program management experience supporting ADP Lyric implementations from planning through go-live and stabilization.
Strong understanding of API integrations, system interfaces, and technical dependencies within complex HCM implementations, with the ability to coordinate technical teams, manage integration risks, and drive resolution.
Demonstrated expertise in project governance, including project planning, milestone management, risk and issue oversight, dependency tracking, stakeholder accountability, and executive-level reporting.
Experience serving as a client-side project or program manager, acting as a liaison between the client and software vendor, advocating for client objectives while building a strategic, collaborative vendor partnership.
Ability to lead cross-functional project teams, align business and technical stakeholders, coordinate multiple workstreams, and maintain momentum throughout complex, enterprise-level implementations.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate challenges, assess project risks, and drive timely resolution.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, manage expectations, and establish credibility across executive leadership, client teams, vendor partners, and internal project teams.
Advanced relationship management skills, including the ability to balance client advocacy with vendor collaboration, navigate competing priorities, and maintain productive partnerships throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Skilled in de-escalation, conflict resolution, and stakeholder alignment, with the ability to manage challenging situations, facilitate difficult conversations, and drive productive, outcome-focused resolutions.
Demonstrated ability to create structure, clarity, and alignment across multiple stakeholders in complex, fast-moving environments while maintaining accountability for project outcomes.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, workstreams, and dependencies while maintaining visibility into project health, progress, and deliverables.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive approach to identifying risks, driving solutions, enforcing governance, and keeping projects moving forward.
Comfortable leading independently and collaboratively in fast-paced, evolving settings, with the leadership presence and judgment to provide direction and confidence throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent) is a plus.

Why enhanceHCM?

At enhanceHCM, we strive for excellence in every engagement and seek solution-driven professionals who thrive on making an impact. As a Lyric Implementation Project Manager, you'll play a key role as an individual contributor who leads with purpose - guiding clients, coordinating project teams, and aligning seamlessly with vendors and partners to ensure unified, successful outcomes.
We foster a collaborative culture that values proactive thinking, professional growth, and balance. With a flexible remote environment and a team of high-performing experts by your side, you'll have the support and freedom to do your best work-while building a career that reflects your strengths and aspirations.

Location: Remote: California.

Location Status: Requires 25%-50% travel, including occasional overnight travel. Work will be primarily performed remotely from home office. Occasional travel to and work from other Race offices or off-site locations may be required.

Free Fiber Internet Service

Comp: $71,000-$79,000 USD per year

Who We Are:

We're more than a fiber internet provider, we're your neighbors, committed to connecting California communities since 1994. At Race, relationships matter as much as speed. We combine cutting-edge technology with a genuine, people-first approach that makes every interaction feel personal. Our team operates like family: collaborative, supportive, and dedicated to making a real difference. When you join Race, you're not just accepting a job, you're becoming part of a team that values integrity, celebrates wins together and believes that meaningful work happens when great people connect with great purpose.

Position Impact:

The Sales Training Program Manager is responsible for owning, managing, and continuously improving the company's sales training infrastructure to drive consistent, high-level performance across inside sales and door-to-door (D2D) sales channels, including contractor teams. This role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of onboarding programs, manages and optimizes the LMS platform (Articulate 360), and develops and scales training frameworks such as train-the-trainer models for both internal teams and external partners. The position plays a key role in enabling sales effectiveness by designing, coordinating, and delivering training across diverse sales environments, including inside sales and field-based D2D teams. The Manager provides hands-on coaching to sales representatives and frontline leadership, reinforcing core selling skills, improving execution, and ensuring alignment with company standards, messaging, and customer experience expectations.

Operating with a high level of ownership, this role partners cross-functionally with Sales Leadership, Operations, Sales Training, and contractor teams to establish program priorities, align training initiatives with business objectives, monitor effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement. The role is accountable for training program consistency, execution, and measurable impact on sales performance, onboarding effectiveness, and overall business outcomes. The Sales Training Program Manager leads the ongoing evolution of a scalable, high-impact sales training ecosystem that supports business growth and consistent execution across markets and sales channels.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience:

Eligibility for US Employment without sponsorship
Minimum of 18 years of age
Associate degree (A.A.) or equivalent education in a related field of study preferred
High School Diploma or GED or equivalent combination of education and experience is required
A valid driver's license, subject to successful verification through a DMV check, is mandatory
Ability to travel to multiple work sites and maintain a flexible schedule based on the needs of the Sales organization, including evenings, overnight, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required
3-5 years of experience in sales, sales training, enablement, or coaching roles, with increasing responsibility in training program ownership, development, implementation, or optimization
Proven success supporting both inside sales (phone-based) and outside sales (field or door-to-door) environments, including experience working with or training contractor teams
Demonstrated ability to own, manage, and continuously improve training programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Strong public speaking, presentation, and facilitation skills with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences, including frontline teams and leadership
Experience developing structured training content, onboarding programs, and instructional materials that drive measurable performance outcomes
Proficiency with Salesforce, LMS platforms (Articulate 360 preferred), sales enablement tools, and data/reporting dashboards (e.g., SalesRabbit or similar)
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable training improvements and measurable business results
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
Demonstrated ability to manage training program priorities, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across multiple sales channels
Experience establishing program success metrics, evaluating training effectiveness, and using performance data to guide continuous improvement
Experience in telecommunications or other rapid-growth, performance-driven industries strongly preferred
The ability to effectively communicate in English, including speaking, reading, writing, and comprehension, as necessary for effective job performance and workplace communication
Bilingual communication skills are considered a plus, particularly when serving diverse communities

Skills:

Proficient use of MS Office applications including Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; teleconferencing applications
Functional use of common office equipment, computers, and office software

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Training Strategy & Program Ownership

Own the strategy, ongoing management, and continuous improvement of sales training programs to ensure alignment with business goals, sales strategy, and customer experience standards
Identify performance gaps across inside sales, D2D, and contractor teams and develop targeted, scalable training solutions
Align training initiatives with sales campaigns, promotions, and go-to-market priorities
Track, measure, and report on training effectiveness and overall business impact
Establish program objectives, success measures, and priorities to ensure training initiatives deliver measurable business results
Manage training program timelines, resources, and deliverables to support consistent execution across sales channels
Own and maintain centralized storage and organization of training records, materials, completion data, and program documentation to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and reliable reporting across sales channels

Training Program Design & Delivery

Design and implement structured training programs for inside sales, field (D2D), and contractor teams, including onboarding, skills development, and advanced selling techniques
Develop engaging curriculum covering customer discovery, objection handling, product knowledge, CRM utilization, and sales strategy
Facilitate recurring training sessions to reinforce core competencies and introduce new sales concepts
Evaluate and optimize training content, delivery methods, and learning experiences based on participant feedback, performance data, and evolving business needs
Ensure training programs are scalable, repeatable, and consistently delivered across regions and sales channels

Sales Onboarding

Own the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires across inside sales, field teams, and contractor channels to ensure consistent ramp and readiness
Deliver blended learning experiences including classroom, virtual, and hands-on field training
Coordinate onboarding schedules in alignment with hiring plans, contractor onboarding, and business needs
Define and monitor onboarding milestones and readiness criteria to improve time-to-productivity and ensure consistent new-hire preparation across channels

Ongoing Development & Coaching

Facilitate ongoing workshops, role-playing sessions, and refresher training to support continuous skill development
Implement and scale a train-the-trainer model to enable Sales Managers and contractor leaders to reinforce coaching in the field
Maintain and continuously improve training resources including scripts, playbooks, and best-practice guides
Develop and maintain a structured training calendar and ongoing development roadmap aligned with sales performance needs and business priorities
Assess the effectiveness of ongoing development initiatives and recommend enhancements to strengthen skill adoption and retention

Field Training & Market Support

Travel to regional markets to support new territory launches and provide in-field coaching for D2D and contractor sales teams
Shadow sales representatives and provide real-time coaching and performance feedback
Tailor training support based on local market dynamics, team performance, and contractor needs
Identify recurring field performance trends and translate findings into program enhancements, standardized resources, and targeted training interventions

Performance Monitoring & Program Effectiveness

Analyze sales performance data to identify trends, skill gaps, and training opportunities across channels
Partner with Sales Managers, Supervisors, and L&D to support development plans for underperforming team members
Deliver targeted coaching interventions to improve individual and team performance
Establish and monitor program-level performance metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, knowledge retention, skill application, and impact on sales outcomes
Use performance insights and stakeholder feedback to recommend program adjustments and prioritize continuous improvement initiatives
Communicate program performance, progress against objectives, and improvement opportunities to relevant stakeholders

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment

Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, HR, L&D, and Operations to ensure training content reflects current campaigns, messaging, and business priorities
Partner with internal stakeholders to track training completion, ensure compliance, and support onboarding and reporting processes
Coordinate with contractor partners to ensure consistent training standards and execution
Serve as the primary program owner and point of coordination for sales training initiatives, aligning stakeholders on program priorities, deliverables, and outcomes
Drive cross-functional alignment to ensure training programs remain current, consistent, and responsive to changes in products, processes, sales strategy, and market needs

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Time-to-productivity for new hires across inside sales, D2D, and contractor channels
Training completion, adoption, and engagement rates
Measurable improvement in sales performance following training interventions
Coaching effectiveness and impact on individual and team performance
Consistency of training execution across regions and contractor teams
Achievement of established training program objectives, milestones, and deliverables
Improvement in knowledge retention, skill application, and post-training performance outcomes
Training program effectiveness and return on investment, where measurable

Maintains a clean driving record as defined by the current fleet insurance underwriter
Requires 25%-50% travel, including occasional overnight travel

jobs.description:
Company Description
EHN Consulting LLC is a professional services firm that provides strategic planning and insights to food and beverage and dairy industries. The company focuses on delivering reliable, efficient, and cost-effective solutions that help organizations meet complex operational and strategic goals. EHN Consulting LLC emphasizes collaboration, clear communication, and accountability in all client engagements. Team members work in a flexible, largely remote environment while maintaining high standards of performance and client service.

Job description;

An Idaho based dairy manufacturing plant owned by based in Southern Idaho is developing a 35-acre greenfield site. They seek an experienced dairy or food industry leader to coordinate the development and launch of a new dairy plant. The individual does not need to be proficient in every aspect described below. They will be able to bring in specialist expertise and consultants as needed. The essential capability is to lead people, manage multiple tasks and workstreams concurrently, establish priorities, and coordinate partners to keep the project moving forward.
Working closely with an engaged ownership group and advisors, the Project Leader will guide the business through financing, customer commitments, engineering, construction, equipment installation, commissioning, and commercial startup. The role carries significant responsibility and autonomy, with major commitments subject to ownership approval.

Timing and location;

The role may commence part time in the next few months, with the goal of transitioning to full-time work and assuming project leadership in January 2027 following a structured handover. We expect the assignment to last at least 18 months. Following commissioning, there is potential to transition into a plant leadership position, such as Operations, General Manager or CEO, subject to mutual agreement and ownership approval.
The role may be remote, with travel to the site, and substantial on-site involvement as construction, commissioning, and startup progress. Annual full-time salary: $200,000. Travel and per diem expenses will be paid for with approval. Compensation for any initial part-time period will be agreed separately.

Key Responsibilities;

Lead the business and project.
Translate ownership objectives into an integrated execution plan. Coordinate concurrent workstreams, assign accountability, drive timely decisions, manage risks and contingencies, and report clearly on progress, spending, and decisions requiring approval. Serve as the principal management contact for project partners.
Build the commercial foundation.
Develop customer relationships and secure multi-year offtake agreements. Align product specifications, quality, volumes, pricing, launch timing, and capacity commitments with the plant design, production plans, and financial projections.
Coordinate financing and financial planning.
Oversee and refine the business plan, pro forma, budgets, cash requirements, and cost-to-completion forecasts with financial advisers. Work with ownership and advisors to secure equity investors, coordinate investor and lender due diligence, and secure financing. Pursue appropriate grants, loan guarantees, tax credits, and incentives with USDA, State of Idaho, and local Municipality.
Oversee engineering construction and equipment.
Lead the owner’s relationship with engineers, contractors, suppliers, and consultants. Oversee and provide feedback to engineers on facility design, equipment procurement and installation, utilities, automation, and testing. Track cost, schedule, quality, safety, contractor performance, and changes requiring approval.

Additional Responsibilities;

Prepare the organization for operations.
 Assist in search and hiring of operations manager who will coordinate milk supply, ingredients, packaging, cold storage, logistics, maintenance, staffing, training, and operating systems. Build the initial team and ensure food safety, quality, production planning, customer approvals, and traceability requirements are addressed.
Lead commissioning and commercial startup.
Coordinate with engineering, equipment suppliers, operations, quality, and maintenance through equipment testing, sanitation validation, product trials, troubleshooting, and the production ramp. Establish readiness and acceptance criteria and track capacity, yield, quality, cost, safety, and efficiency.
Coordinate permitting and compliance.
Work with the local Municipality , State of Idaho, USDA, and other agencies on permits and project requirements. Engage legal and technical advisers for environmental, wastewater, food safety, workplace safety, contracts, insurance, and other compliance matters.

Essential Qualifications;   

At least 10 years of relevant dairy or food industry experience, with sound understanding of dairy processing and plant operations.
·      Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects, manage multiple priorities concurrently, and coordinate internal teams, outside specialists, and consultants.
·      Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to oversee budgets and financial models, assess assumptions, and recognize when specialist advice is needed.
·      Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to build productive relationships with owners, customers, investors, lenders, engineers, contractors, and agencies.
·      Strong organizational skills, practical problem solving, and clear accountability for decisions and follow-through.
·      Proficiency with Microsoft, Google, and Adobe platforms for communication, documentation, and project coordination. Engagement with AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT beneficial.
·      Willingness to travel and maintain substantial on-site involvement during construction, commissioning, and startup.

Helpful Experience

Experience with dairy or food manufacturing business is preferred. Other useful experience includes capital projects or greenfield development; customer offtake agreements; equity and debt financing; grants and incentives; engineering and construction oversight; and commissioning or operating-team development. Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every one of these areas.

Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A Little More About Your Role…

We are looking for Delivery Leads, (Project Managers/Directors and Assistant Project Managers), to manage high-value, challenging projects and programmes within the Defence and Security sector. In this role, you will report to the Senior Delivery Lead and be responsible for delivering projects according to the project plan. Assistant Project Managers will either support larger projects and programmes or take the lead on smaller projects as Project Managers.

As a growing and diverse team, tackling complex infrastructure projects that span the RIBA design stages.

As well as delighting our growing client base we are developing a strong defence and security culture within WSP. MOD policy, processes and procedures

The Green Book and 5 case model for business cases

An existing network within the Defence and Security sector

NEC3/4 PM qualification

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

With us, you can. Apply today.

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

The successful candidate will lead a multidisciplinary team delivering enterprise IT services, including cybersecurity, network operations, cloud infrastructure, application development, data analytics, IT service management, and emerging technology solutions supporting approximately 3,600 Government personnel.

This position requires a proven leader with extensive experience managing complex Department of Defense (DoD) IT contracts, directing technical teams, maintaining compliance with Army and DoD cybersecurity requirements, and delivering measurable results against cost, schedule, and performance objectives.

Requirements

Program and Contract Management

Serve as the primary contractor point of contact for the Contracting Officer (KO), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), OCIO leadership, and other Government stakeholders.
Provide overall leadership, management, and oversight of all contract activities, personnel, subcontractors, and technical service delivery.
Establish and enforce program management processes, performance standards, schedules, quality controls, and operational procedures.
Manage contract financial performance, including budgets, cost controls, funding execution, labor allocations, and expenditure reporting.
Develop, implement, and maintain the Program Management Plan (PMP) in accordance with contract requirements, including CDRL A001.
Monitor program schedules, milestones, deliverables, and performance metrics to ensure compliance with contractual requirements.
Identify, assess, document, and mitigate program risks, performance deficiencies, and operational challenges.
Manage multiple simultaneous projects, Technical Directives (TDs), and subcontractor activities.
Lead transition-in and transition-out planning to ensure continuity of mission-critical IT services.

Personnel and Resource Management

Direct and supervise contractor personnel across multiple technical and functional disciplines.
Establish and maintain a clearly defined organizational structure, reporting hierarchy, and escalation procedures.
Coordinate workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, personnel allocation, training, and retention activities.
Ensure all assigned personnel possess the required security clearances, technical certifications, education, and experience before performing applicable contract tasks.
Monitor staffing levels, workforce utilization, skills alignment, and resource availability to meet evolving mission requirements.
Collaborate with OCIO leadership to evaluate resource allocation and recommend adjustments based on operational priorities.
Maintain accurate staffing records, organizational charts, personnel directories, and reporting structures.

Technical Leadership and Oversight

Provide technical leadership and management oversight for enterprise IT operations, including systems administration, network engineering, cybersecurity, application development, cloud services, and IT service management.
Oversee the planning, design, implementation, integration, modernization, and sustainment of enterprise IT solutions.
Maintain working knowledge of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, advanced analytics, cloud architectures, virtualization, and automation.
Ensure IT services comply with applicable Army and DoD cybersecurity policies, technical standards, and regulatory requirements.
Provide oversight of DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, cybersecurity documentation, system authorization requirements, and network configuration management.
Coordinate with technical leadership to identify opportunities for operational efficiency, process automation, technology modernization, and continuous service improvement.
Support the implementation and improvement of IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)-aligned service management practices.

Government Relations and Performance Reporting

Maintain effective working relationships with Government leadership, program stakeholders, subcontractors, and technical teams.
Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, program status presentations, and contract performance reviews.
Provide accurate and timely reports covering program costs, schedules, staffing, accomplishments, risks, issues, and performance metrics.
Oversee preparation and submission of contract deliverables, including Enterprise IT Performance Metrics (CDRL A002) and the Contracting Officer's Management Report (CDRL A003).
Track key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreements (SLAs), customer satisfaction, and service delivery effectiveness.
Participate in technical working groups, cybersecurity reviews, architecture meetings, program management reviews, service desk reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
Promptly communicate significant incidents, risks, performance deficiencies, and corrective actions to Government stakeholders.
Present recommendations to Government leadership to enhance service delivery, improve operational effectiveness, and reduce program risks.

jobs.description:
Project Manager II - Implementation Project Manager

Location: Remote within Wisconsin

Employment Type: Contract

Anticipated Start: Late November 2026

Initial Duration: Through June 30, 2027, with potential for extension

Schedule: Must be available during core Central Time business hours

Position Overview

The Wisconsin Department of Children and Families (DCF) is seeking an experienced Implementation Project Manager to support a large-scale modernization initiative focused on implementing a new case management system.
This position will oversee and coordinate implementation activities leading up to and throughout pilot and system rollout. The Implementation Project Manager will work across project management, organizational change management (OCM), training, technical teams, implementation leadership, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure the organization is prepared for each stage of implementation.
This role is particularly focused on implementation planning, organizational readiness, stakeholder coordination, communications, training readiness, pilot execution, and phased system rollout. The Project Manager will oversee day-to-day implementation activities, track progress and issues, coordinate dependencies across teams, and help ensure the organization is prepared to transition from the existing environment to the modernized system.
Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive implementation and communication plans for a large-scale system modernization initiative.
* Oversee implementation activities leading up to and during pilot, go-live, and phased regional system rollouts.
* Coordinate functional and technical implementation activities across project teams, vendors, and DCF stakeholders.
* Partner closely with Project Management, Organizational Change Management, Training, and implementation leadership to ensure organizational readiness.
* Track implementation activities, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and overall progress.
* Coordinate with project leadership to resolve implementation issues within required timeframes.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting regarding implementation progress, readiness, risks, and potential issues.
* Develop and maintain acceptance and readiness criteria for major implementation milestones, including:
○ UAT to pilot
○ Pilot to system rollout
○ Subsequent regional rollout phases
* Coordinate state-level activities required to maintain alignment between legacy systems and the modernized system during pilot and rollout.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings between business, technical, OCM, training, vendor, and project teams.
* Coordinate with implementation vendors to ensure required hardware and software are available prior to scheduled go-live dates.
* Support planning for periods in which legacy and new systems may operate simultaneously.
* Partner with Training and Organizational Change Management teams to confirm required training and communications are completed prior to implementation.
* Ensure project teams and stakeholders are informed of upcoming implementation activities, timelines, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate activities related to system rollout, site support, user readiness, user account provisioning, and defect/issue reporting.
* Identify potential implementation challenges and recommend appropriate process, policy, or procedural changes when necessary.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
Required Qualifications

Candidates should have 11+ years of experience in:
* Project management.
* Developing and implementing project implementation plans and communication plans.
* Building and maintaining collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholder groups.
Candidates should also have demonstrated experience with:
* Large-scale system implementations and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Coordinating complex implementation activities across multiple project teams and stakeholder groups.
* Organizational change, implementation readiness, and training efforts.
* Project leadership and management.
* Managing competing priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Written and verbal communication, including developing and delivering presentations to stakeholders.
* Facilitating cross-functional meetings and driving activities toward implementation milestones.
Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting federal or state government programs.
* Federal Child Support Program experience.
* Experience implementing or modernizing large-scale case management systems.
* Experience working alongside Organizational Change Management, training, technical, and implementation teams.
* Experience supporting phased implementations involving pilot programs and regional rollouts.
Project Environment

This position will support the Child Support Modernization Project, which is implementing a new case management system. The Implementation Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders and will be responsible for overseeing and tracking implementation progress, coordinating day-to-day activities, and ensuring teams remain aligned throughout pilot and rollout.
The position requires someone who can operate across both the business and technical sides of an implementation. The individual will not simply maintain a project plan. They will actively coordinate teams, surface and resolve implementation issues, manage readiness activities, and ensure the appropriate pieces are in place for successful go-live and rollout.
Remote Work Requirements

* Candidates must currently reside in Wisconsin or be willing to relocate to Wisconsin within 30 days of the start date at their own expense.
* The position is approximately 90-100% remote, although occasional onsite work may be required with appropriate notice.
* Candidates must be physically located within the United States, and work cannot be performed outside the U.S.
* Candidates must be available during required Central Time business hours.
* The selected candidate will be responsible for providing their own computer equipment, reliable internet connection, camera, and headset for remote work.
* No regular on-call or weekend coverage is required.
