jobs.title: Program Manager, Water Services
jobs.description:
Job description

Reporting to the Manager of Public Engagement & Connection Services, the Program Manager – Water Systems is responsible for the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of programs that enhance the efficiency, accountability, reliability, and sustainability of CK PUC drinking water distribution systems.

The position leads programs to quantify and manage accounted-for and unaccounted-for water through water audits, water loss analysis, optimized flushing practices, leak detection, and identification of unauthorized water use. Using operational data, technology, performance measures, regulatory guidance, and industry best practices, the Program Manager identifies opportunities to reduce water loss, improve distribution system performance, support infrastructure planning, and promote the efficient use of treated drinking water.

Working collaboratively with internal departments, Entegrus, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, Source Protection Authorities, and other stakeholders, the position provides technical expertise, program oversight, policy development, budget monitoring, and recommendations to management and Commission. The position also supports CK PUC's source-to-tap approach to drinking water management through source water protection, regulatory best practices, water conservation, system performance, and public education. Ontario identifies source protection as the first step in its multi-barrier, source-to-tap drinking water protection framework.

Essential responsibilities

Demonstrate Chatham-Kent’s core values and competencies
Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive water accountability program, including water audits to quantify accounted-for and unaccounted-for water, identify system losses, establish performance targets, and support water loss reduction initiatives.
Develop and oversee leak detection, unauthorized water use investigations, flushing optimization, and related programs that improve distribution system efficiency, reliability, and accountability.
Evaluate flushing practices and seasonal programs to minimize unnecessary discharge of treated water while maintaining water quality requirements, including appropriate flushing of dead-end watermains.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, key performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting tools to measure water loss, flushing volumes, leak detection, water use, system efficiency, and overall program performance.
Analyze operational, infrastructure, consumption, and financial data to identify trends and improvement opportunities and prepare reports, business cases, recommendations, and presentations for management, Commissioners, and senior leadership.
Lead the implementation, administration, and optimization of technologies and software supporting water system performance, including leak detection, pressure and flow monitoring, smart metering (AMI/AMR), GIS, SCADA, data analytics, and related systems.
Research and evaluate emerging technologies, industry practices, and process improvements that enhance water accountability, operational efficiency, asset performance, and customer service.
Support asset management, watermain condition assessment, lifecycle planning, master planning, and infrastructure prioritization by incorporating system performance, condition, water loss, and operational data into decision-making.
Assist with operating and capital budget development, procurement, business cases, grant opportunities, and long-term program planning; monitor program, equipment, and related expenditures against approved budgets.
Develop and maintain policies, procedures, standards, service levels, and quality assurance practices supporting water accountability, conservation, flushing, leak detection, distribution system performance, and regulatory compliance.
Lead the review and integration of applicable MECP Drinking Water System Best Management Practices and industry standards into water system programs, risk management, performance measures, policies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support CK PUC's drinking water source protection responsibilities by collaborating with internal departments, Source Protection Authorities, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to identify and address risks to municipal drinking water sources and incorporate applicable source protection policies and best practices into water system planning and programs. Ontario's source protection framework uses locally developed, science-based plans to identify vulnerable drinking water areas, threats, and actions to protect municipal drinking water sources.
Build and maintain effective relationships with internal departments, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, industry partners, and other stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives related to water system performance and continuous improvement.
Serve as the primary liaison with Entegrus field personnel for water program activities, including equipment purchases and deployment, program delivery, contractor performance, and monitoring associated operating and capital expenditures.
Support public education and communications related to CK PUC drinking water systems, source water protection, water conservation, water loss, and system initiatives through the CK PUC website, social media, and other communication channels. Education and outreach are among the tools used in Ontario's source water protection framework.

Essential qualifications

Three-year post-secondary diploma or university degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, Engineering Technology, Applied Science, Environmental Studies, Water Resources, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of related education and experience.
Four (4) to six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in municipal water distribution, water/wastewater utilities, infrastructure management, engineering, asset management, water resources, or a related field.
Demonstrated knowledge of municipal drinking water and distribution systems, with experience in one or more of the following: water loss management, water auditing, leak detection, flushing programs, utility data analysis, infrastructure condition assessment, asset management, water conservation, or municipal program management.
Experience with program development, project coordination, performance measurement, data analysis, budget monitoring, and preparation of technical reports, policies, procedures, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, project management, and stakeholder relationship skills.
Strong computer skills with experience using data management, mapping, analytics, reporting, or water utility software applications.

Other qualifications

The following would be considered assets:
Ontario Water Distribution Operator Certification.
Certified Engineering Technologist (CET), Certified Technician (C.Tech.), Professional Engineer (P.Eng.), Project Management Professional (PMP), or related professional designation.
Experience with GIS, SCADA, hydraulic modelling, AMI/smart metering, pressure and flow monitoring, leak detection technologies, Power BI, and AWWA Water Audit Software.
Experience applying water loss control, drinking water best management practices, source water protection principles, or asset management practices.
Experience in a municipal government or public utility environment.
Experience developing policies, procedures, service levels, performance frameworks, procurement documentation, business cases, or grant and funding applications.

Certifications, memberships, licenses

Membership and registration with the Ontario Association of Certified Engineering Technicians and Technologists as a CET or with Professional Engineers Ontario as a P.Eng., or another relevant professional organization is preferred.

Work environment/hours of work

This position works both indoors and outdoors
This position is required to work weekday hours, with occasional evening hours

Driver’s licence/vehicle requirements

This position requires the successful candidate to have a valid class G Ontario driver’s licence; a driver’s abstract will be conducted by the Municipality of Chatham-Kent. An acceptable driver’s abstract will: be an original document and current (within the previous thirty (30) days); have no more than four (4) demerit points; have no more than two (2) convictions for the same offence; have no criminal code convictions; have no ‘non-medical or administrative’ license suspension in the preceding three (3) years. Because this position may be required to drive their own vehicle, a reliable vehicle is also required.

Essential physical and/or safety requirements

Walking: frequent walking to/from printers,meetings etc. Sometimes visiting treatment plants
Sitting: frequent sitting in primary office, meeting locations etc.
Hands: frequent fine finger dexterity (movement), mousing (keyboarding, mousing, data management, preparing reports, reviewing operational data)

Company Description: ProntoPaga

Job Description: ¡Súmate a ProntoPaga!

En ProntoPaga, empresa que forma parte de Worldwide Payments (WWP) Services, holding tecnológico que impulsa el movimiento del dinero en Latinoamérica, desarrollamos soluciones de pago robustas, seguras y escalables para operar a nivel regional. Creemos en la colaboración entre equipos, el aprendizaje continuo y el talento sin fronteras. Buscamos personas curiosas y creativas, con ganas de crecer y asumir nuevos retos junto a un equipo multidisciplinario y comprometido.

Si te motiva trabajar en un entorno dinámico, inclusivo y con impacto real… ¡este es tu lugar!

Buscamos a un/a profesional con sólida experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, enfoque analítico, pensamiento crítico, autonomía en la gestión y capacidad para liderar iniciativas de principio a fin, promoviendo una cultura de seguridad alineada con los objetivos estratégicos de la organización.

Su principal propósito será fortalecer la gestión de los riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, ciberseguridad y tecnología mediante la definición, implementación y mejora continua de políticas, estándares, controles y mecanismos de supervisión, así como realizar una evaluación independiente de su cumplimiento por parte de las áreas responsables de la operación de los procesos y controles (primera línea de defensa).

El cargo tendrá un rol clave en la administración, mantenimiento y mejora continua del Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI), asegurando la conservación y evolución de las certificaciones ISO/IEC 27001 y PCI DSS existentes, además de contribuir al fortalecimiento del marco de gobierno de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad de la organización.

Asimismo, será responsable de promover una adecuada gestión de riesgos y cumplimiento normativo, asegurando el alineamiento de las prácticas de seguridad con los objetivos del negocio, las exigencias regulatorias, las obligaciones contractuales y las mejores prácticas internacionales.

Como función de segunda línea de defensa, deberá proporcionar supervisión, asesoría especializada y monitoreo independiente sobre la efectividad de los controles de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad, contribuyendo a la protección de los activos de información, los sistemas tecnológicos y los datos sensibles de la organización.

Su gestión deberá contribuir al fortalecimiento de la continuidad operacional, la resiliencia operacional y digital, la protección de la información financiera, comercial y personal, así como a mantener la confianza de clientes, socios estratégicos, organismos reguladores y demás partes interesadas, velando permanentemente por la confidencialidad, integridad y disponibilidad de la información.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?

Administrar, mantener y mejorar continuamente el Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI), asegurando su alineamiento con los requisitos de ISO/IEC 27001 y otros estándares aplicables.
Asegurar que las políticas, procedimientos, estándares y controles de Seguridad de la Información se mantengan actualizados, documentados y adecuadamente implementados en la organización.
Integrar los requisitos de seguridad de la información en procesos de negocio, operaciones y tecnología.
Identificar, evaluar y gestionar riesgos de Seguridad de la Información asociados a activos de información, procesos, proyectos, tecnologías y servicios críticos.
Liderar la coordinación de auditorías, evaluaciones de cumplimiento y procesos de certificación en materias de Seguridad de la Información, gestionando la atención de requerimientos, evidencias, observaciones y planes de remediación asociados.
Revisar y evaluar el cumplimiento de los estándares de configuración segura definidos por la organización.
Mantener actualizado el registro y análisis de riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, realizando seguimiento periódico a los planes de tratamiento y verificando la implementación efectiva de las medidas de mitigación definidas
Elaborar y reportar métricas e indicadores de desempeño, riegos y cumplimiento asociados a seguridad de la información.
Apoyar programas de capacitación, concientización y fortalecimiento de la cultura de seguridad de la información.
Responder cuestionarios de seguridad, due diligence y requerimientos de clientes de forma clara y oportuna.
Gestionar y supervisar los procesos relacionados con la gestión de identidades y accesos, velando por la aplicación de los principios de mínimo privilegio y segregación de funciones.
Promover buenas prácticas de protección de la información en toda la organización.
Gestionar riesgos de seguridad asociados a terceros.
Evaluar riesgos de seguridad en proyectos, nuevos desarrollos e implementaciones tecnológicas.
Elaborar reportes y presentaciones para instancias de gobierno ejecutivas y comités.
Generar nuevas iniciativas en ámbitos de seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad.
Colaborar con equipos técnicos, operacionales y de negocio para apoyar la mitigación de riesgos y la implementación de controles alineados con la estrategia de Seguridad de la Información.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?

Formación

Profesional titulado(a) de Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería en Ciberseguridad, Ingeniería Civil Informática, Ingeniería en Sistemas o carrera afín.

Experiencia

Contar con al menos 5 años de experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, Ciberseguridad, Gestión de Riesgos Tecnológicos o funciones relacionadas.
Poseer al menos 3 años de experiencia en roles asociados a gobierno, riesgo, cumplimiento (GRC) o funciones de segunda línea de defensa.
Deseable experiencia en organizaciones reguladas del sector financiero, Fintech, medios de pago, seguros u otras industrias con altos requerimientos regulatorios.
Experiencia en cumplimiento normativos y regulatorios en seguridad de la información.
Experiencia en procesos de certificación, mantención o auditoría de ISO/IEC 27001 y/o PCI DSS.
Experiencia en evaluación de riesgos de terceros, proveedores y servicios externalizados.
Experiencia en gestión de riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, riesgos tecnológicos y riesgos de ciberseguridad.

Conocimientos

Conocimientos en gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM), segregación de funciones y controles de acceso.
Conocimientos de seguridad en entornos Cloud.
Conocimientos generales de tecnologías y plataformas de seguridad/ciberseguridad.
Conocimientos de estándares, frameworks y buenas prácticas tales como: ISO/IEC 27001 e ISO/IEC 27002, PCI-DSS, NIST CSF, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST SP 800, CIS Controls.
Manejo de Inglés Técnico intermedio (oral y escrito).

Seu Papel e Impacto

O(a) Project Manager será responsável por monitorar e controlar as diferentes etapas do fornecimento de equipamentos novos e/ou reparados. Atuará como integrador(a) do processo, garantindo que todos os aspectos negociados e acordados no momento da venda sejam cumpridos, com atenção especial aos principais indicadores do projeto, como margem, fluxo de caixa, prazo de entrega e qualidade.
Quando aplicável, será responsável por negociar revisões técnicas e comerciais relacionadas ao escopo de fornecimento. Também atuará como principal ponto de contato com os clientes para atualização sobre o andamento dos projetos, além de coordenar atividades internas e externas por meio dos sistemas e ferramentas de gestão de projetos existentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

•    Gerenciar projetos desde o recebimento do pedido de compra do cliente até a entrega final do produto e/ou serviço, adotando uma abordagem centrada no cliente e priorizando a segurança em todas as etapas.
•    Realizar análises comerciais e técnicas de contratos, coordenando-se, quando necessário, com as áreas de Vendas, Jurídico e Contabilidade, conforme as políticas internas.
•    Garantir que o escopo do projeto esteja claramente definido e que toda a documentação fornecida pelo cliente e demais documentos necessários estejam disponíveis para o início das atividades.
•    Desenvolver, comunicar e acompanhar o cronograma do projeto, contemplando avaliações em campo, engenharia, compras, fabricação, instalação, resolução de pendências e encerramento do projeto.
•    Elaborar, comunicar e monitorar o orçamento do projeto, bem como controles financeiros e de pedidos de compra.
•    Gerenciar prazos e resultados financeiros dos projetos, assegurando entregas dentro do prazo e orçamento, acompanhamento de custos e margens, identificação de alternativas qualificadas de menor custo e foco na rentabilidade para a Flowserve.
•    Preparar e apresentar atualizações semanais e mensais dos projetos para a liderança e para as áreas internas de Vendas.
•    Garantir que os processos e formulários aplicáveis sejam devidamente documentados e seguidos, assegurando a administração profissional dos pedidos de acordo com o escopo contratado.
•    Coordenar a equipe do projeto para garantir a melhor execução do escopo, incluindo avaliações em campo, engenharia, suprimentos, qualidade, fabricação e preparação de documentação.
•    Gerenciar a comunicação com os clientes, garantindo o fluxo adequado de informações para manter o andamento do projeto.
•    Coordenar a elaboração, envio e aprovação de documentos exigidos pelo cliente e pela Flowserve, atuando sobre alterações ou informações necessárias e comunicando as partes envolvidas.
•    Facilitar a resolução ágil de problemas, riscos e gargalos que possam impactar o projeto.
•    Gerenciar solicitações de alteração de escopo, trabalhando em conjunto com a área Comercial para obter a aprovação do cliente quanto a ajustes de preço e prazo de entrega.
•    Coordenar, programar e acompanhar visitas de inspetores de clientes e/ou seus representantes para inspeções de fabricação, estudos HAZOP e Testes de Aceitação em Fábrica (FAT).
•    Realizar o encerramento dos projetos e elaborar um resumo final para as partes interessadas da Flowserve, incluindo resultados financeiros e lições aprendidas.

Qualificações Obrigatórias

•    Experiência em Gestão de Projetos ou em posições relacionadas à gestão.
•    Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.
•    Inglês fluente.
•    Forte habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal, organização, planejamento e comunicação.
•    Conhecimento técnico em área relacionada ao escopo dos projetos.
•    Domínio de Microsoft Project, Word, Excel e Outlook.
•    Capacidade de atuar com foco no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades e objetivos, propondo soluções dentro do escopo do projeto ou identificando oportunidades de ampliação do escopo e do pedido de compra.
•    Capacidade de identificar oportunidades adicionais junto aos clientes e comunicar produtos ou serviços Flowserve que possam contribuir para seus objetivos.
•    Experiência comprovada na coordenação de projetos com foco contínuo em segurança.
•    Conhecimento de equipamentos rotativos utilizados nas indústrias de Óleo e Gás, Refino, Petroquímica e Dutos.
•    Capacidade de identificar soluções ou mobilizar equipes e fornecedores para resolver questões que impactem custo, segurança, qualidade e prazo.
•    Capacidade de ler e interpretar desenhos mecânicos, esquemas, diagramas de tubulação e instrumentação (P&IDs), desenhos de layout, diagramas elétricos, de instrumentação e interligações.

Qualificações Desejáveis

•    Experiência prévia na indústria metalúrgica, especialmente com selos mecânicos.

Our collaborative approach connects instructional practices with thoughtful design, creating modern spaces that prepare future-ready students and deliver measurable outcomes. We are a mission-driven, impact-focused company backed by Bain Capital Double Impact, committed to improving educational outcomes through better learning environments.

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants, uncrewed platforms, and aircraft carriers—HII is able to ensure a high state of readiness driven by their technical and sustainment expertise.

Leadership at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Develop talent, empower teams, and build an inclusive environment.
Build Relationships – Strengthen trust, collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.
Take Ownership – Drive accountability, execution excellence, and results.
Customer First – Anticipate mission needs and deliver value to our partners.
Shape the Future – Inspire innovation and align work with strategic priorities.
Act with Urgency – Make informed decisions and move with purpose.

These capabilities define how leaders inspire teams, deliver results, and shape the future of Mission Technologies.

Summary

Join HII as we keep the world's most powerful Navy afloat! The Fleet Sustainment team is currently looking for a Logistics Project Manager. This position is responsible for supporting the operational management of ongoing logistics program activities and serving as a key liaison between program management, planning, project teams, and line leadership. Responsibilities include reviewing project and budget status, coordinating schedules, and preparing routine status reports to ensure program alignment and visibility. The role evaluates project issues and assists in developing effective resolutions that meet productivity, quality, and customer‑satisfaction objectives. Additional duties include creating and implementing mechanisms to monitor project progress and facilitating intervention and problem‑solving efforts in collaboration with project managers, line managers, and clients.

This role is contingent upon contract award.*

Essential Job Responsibilities

Oversee and manage the operational aspects of ongoing logistics program efforts and serve as liaison between program management and planning, and the project team.
Review the status of projects and budgets; manage schedules and prepare status reports.
Assess project issues and develop resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals and objectives.
Develop mechanisms for monitoring project progress and for intervention and problem solving with project managers and clients.
Oversee logistics support planning and execution activities, including maintenance planning, supply support, and training, for surface combatant and other programs.
Coordinate with shipyards, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and other subcontractors on materials and logistics support for ship alteration, repair, and overhaul work packages.
Support configuration management activities documenting the current status of ships, systems, and equipment.

Minimum Qualifications

Ten (10) years of logistics experience, including five (5) years of experience in Navy Project Management involving all aspects of Logistics Support Planning and Execution on surface combatant programs, and five (5) years of experience in logistics planning and execution activities supporting a surface combatant program/project office (i.e., NAVSEA, NSWC, planning yards), to include experience in maintenance planning, supply support, and training.
Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or business-related field.
Foreign Military Sales (FMS) experience.
Full working knowledge of program procedures and practices; ability to monitor daily work operations of exempt and/or non-exempt employees and provide direction to subordinates as required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance; must be a U.S. citizen eligible for such clearance.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including extended stays in support of overseas customer engagements.
Must possess a current passport.
Must be able to obtain base access and a CAC card.

Preferred Requirements

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) certification.
Experience supporting multi-site or complex naval programs, including shipbuilding/overhaul environments.
Experience supporting international customer engagements involving foreign government information and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) handling requirements.
A current or active DoD security clearance.

Physical Requirements

May be required to visit job site in an industrial or shipboard environment. Normally not required to lift more than 40 pounds higher than three feet above feet/floor level.

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok

Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Position Overview:

The Launch Manager is a dedicated, contract-based role embedded within a single brand's Core and Full Matrix launch teams.
Working in close partnership with the Brand Lead, the Launch Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of the launch: driving the launch plan, facilitating cross-functional governance, maintaining the Lx Playbook, and ensuring the team stays on track against the enterprise-wide Launch Excellence (Lx) roadmap - from Launch Initiation through Launch Planning & Execution and into Post-Launch.
This role does not set brand strategy; it operationalizes it, ensuring the full matrix team (Medical, Marketing, Market Access, Regulatory, and other functions) executes against a well-governed, transparent, and continuously updated launch plan.

Responsibilities:

Launch Governance & Team Enablement:
Support the Brand Lead in forming the Launch Core and Full Matrix Teams, ensuring appropriate 3M (Medical, Marketing, Market Access) representation.
Ensure all launch team members have access to, and are onboarded onto, the Lx Playbook and related Lx Resources.
Schedule and support facilitation of all launch project meetings and workshops, ensuring content is prepared in advance by the Full Matrix Team.
Establish and maintain core meeting cadences (Core Team, Full Matrix Team, and governance reviews) in line with the Lx Operational Guidance.
Provide reports and dashboards that support decision-making and cross-functional communication for the Brand Lead and Senior Leadership.
Support tangential launch-related projects in case someone is asked to manage something additional to the direct launch project (i.e. launch meeting, unblinding process, etc.) as requested by the brand / launch lead.

Launch Plan & Lx Playbook Management:
Own active, day-to-day management of the launch plan within the Lx Playbook, ensuring cross-functional deliverables, milestones, dates, and owners are accurate and continuously updated.
Track launch-critical, regulatory, and reimbursement milestone dates and validate them regularly with the Brand Lead and functional leads.
Monitor the Lx Playbook dashboard on a weekly basis, flagging at-risk items, interdependencies, and gaps proactively.
Lead launch scenario and mitigation planning in collaboration with the Core Team.
Provide ongoing navigation and utilization support to active team members.

Prioritization Grid & Promotional Materials Coordination:
Collaborate with all MLR (Marketing, Legal, Regulatory) stakeholders to build and maintain the Prioritization Grid as the single source of truth for cross-functional promotional materials.
Track status and progress of all launch materials, analyze the grid for gaps, and support the Promotional Materials Manager in day-to-day MLR review management, as needed.
Partner with Marketing Ops Manager to support prioritization and force-ranking of materials ahead of Reconciliation reviews to enable on-time 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' execution.

Key Meeting & Milestone Facilitation:
Schedule and co-facilitate (with the Brand Lead) the Full Matrix Team Kick-off Meeting, Walk the Walls Review, and Go-Live Readiness Review.
Drive team preparation and follow-up for each milestone review, including agenda-setting, pre-read materials, and action-item tracking.
Lead post-launch Reconciliation and 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' tactic tracking, capturing actual go-live timing and reporting to the Full Matrix Team.
Lead logistics for Post-Launch Command Center meetings, facilitating agenda development and pre-work status reporting across functions.
Administer the post-launch Launch Review & Survey process, including survey distribution, results consolidation, and reporting to the Full Matrix Team.

Communication & Stakeholder Management:
Execute the launch communication plan, ensuring timely, accurate updates to Core and Matrix Teams at each stage of the launch (kickoff, tactics updates, milestone reviews, regulatory approval, go-live status).
Act as a key liaison between the Brand Lead, Full Matrix Team, and the enterprise Lx Team for support, training, and best-practice guidance.

Launch plan and Lx Playbook maintained at a high level of accuracy and currency (weekly updates, no missed critical dates).
On-time execution of key governance meetings (Kick-off, Walk the Walls, Go-Live Readiness) per the recommended timeline.
Minimal gaps or delays identified during Reconciliation and 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' tracking.
Positive feedback from Full Matrix Team via the post-launch Launch Review & Survey.

Demonstrated experience supporting or managing at least one product launch in a matrixed pharma / biotech environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves customers and developers who rely on storage, compute, and our other service capabilities. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

About The Role

BSI is embarking on a major global Finance Transformation, including the implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning as part of our wider SAP S/4HANA programme.

We are looking for a SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Business Analyst to help bridge the gap between our Finance teams and the technology and implementation teams delivering the programme.

SAC will become a key platform for BSI's FP&A and Commercial Finance teams, supporting budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning. This role will help ensure the solution not only works technically, but is ready for Finance teams to use successfully as it is deployed across BSI.

You will work closely with FP&A, Commercial Finance, regional Finance teams, Deloitte and the wider transformation programme to understand business requirements, support solution design, coordinate testing and data validation, prepare users for deployment and support adoption following go-live.

This is very much a Finance Transformation role rather than a BAU Finance position. You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience of a major global SAC implementation, working across multiple deployment waves and supporting Finance teams through significant process and system change.

Responsibilities

Develop a strong understanding of BSI's new SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solution and how it will support FP&A and Commercial Finance.
Work with Finance stakeholders to gather, challenge, document and validate business and functional requirements.
Help translate Finance requirements into clear functional specifications for Deloitte and technology delivery teams.
Support the design of future-state SAC processes covering budgeting, forecasting, rolling forecasts and long-range planning.
Support the design and validation of SAC planning models, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, approval structures, planning calendars and security requirements.
Help define the readiness and success criteria that must be achieved before SAC is deployed into each country or region.
Support deployment activities across multiple global rollout waves, ensuring Finance teams, processes, data and systems are ready for go-live.
Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including developing test scenarios, scripts and acceptance criteria.
Work directly with Finance users to ensure the system has been thoroughly tested ahead of deployment. System readiness, user testing and training for each deployment were identified as core priorities for the role during the briefing.
Support data mapping, migration, validation and reconciliation between existing and future Finance systems.
Log, track and support the resolution of defects alongside Deloitte and wider programme teams.
Develop training materials, user documentation and work instructions and support end-user training and onboarding.
Support change management and business readiness activities, building relationships with Finance super-users and champions across BSI.
Provide post-go-live hyper-care and help ensure new SAC processes become successfully embedded within the Finance community.
Support the ongoing administration and continuous improvement of SAC following implementation.

To Be Successful In The Role, You Will Have

At least 5 years' experience within FP&A, Commercial Finance, Finance Transformation, Finance Systems or Business Analysis.
Previous experience working directly with FP&A or Finance Business Partnering teams, with a strong understanding of their processes and requirements. This was identified as particularly important during the hiring-manager briefing.
Good knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, planning and management reporting processes.
Experience documenting business processes and translating Finance requirements into functional requirements or specifications.
Experience supporting a Finance system implementation, transformation or migration programme.
Hands-on SAP Analytics Cloud experience would be highly advantageous; experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAC or a comparable enterprise planning platform will also be considered.
Experience moving from one budgeting or planning system to another would be particularly valuable, as it provides first-hand understanding of the user and change journey involved.
Experience planning and executing UAT, including developing testing scenarios and working with end users.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills with the ability to work across Finance, Technology and implementation teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and the ability to manage multiple workstreams within a complex transformation programme.
Experience with Oracle HFM would be beneficial.
An accountancy qualification such as CIMA, ACA or ACCA, or equivalent, would be advantageous.

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 27-days annual leave, paid sick leave, bank holidays, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, car allowance (dependent on role), income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Maternal Health
jobs.description:
The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work http//www.clintonhealthaccess.org

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Program Overview

The Women's & Newborn Health (WNH) Cluster at CHAI aims to reduce unintended pregnancies, maternal and neonatal deaths, and stillbirths by ensuring all individuals are able and empowered to access information, products, and services that meet their sexual, reproductive, maternal, and newborn health (SRMNH) needs.

We pursue global and country-focused market-shaping opportunities for SRMNH products to create an enabling environment for the introduction and scale-up of quality-assured products and services in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). At the global level, we work to ensure that a diversified supplier base can meet demand for key products and ensure commodities are affordable and of high quality. We also coordinate donors and partners around global product strategies. At the country level, CHAI works with governments to steward SRMNH markets and address market imbalances contributing to unequal access to health commodities and services. We support governments to develop national SRMNH scale-up plans with clear targets; use data to coordinate partner resources against the plan and achieve targets; strengthen national forecasting and quantification; address supply chain bottlenecks; strengthen health worker capacity building; and strengthen performance management for the health system.

The WNH Cluster supports the application of global learning and best practices. The team provides thought-partnership and technical assistance to programs implemented by in-country teams who lead CHAI’s valued relationships with partner governments and who possess critical knowledge of local context and operating conditions. Underlying our approach is a commitment to achieving sustainable, transformational change at scale by working in a way that strengthens health systems and government capabilities to improve SRMNH outcomes.

Position Overview

Globally, an estimated 712 women die each day from complications of pregnancy and childbirth and 6,300 newborns die each day with the large majority of these deaths occurring in LMICs. A key reason for these preventable deaths is the lack of diagnostics to identify complex pregnancies and the lack of healthcare worker capacity to manage them accordingly. CHAI is leading an ambitious effort to close this gap by revolutionizing care for pregnant women and paving the way to artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled healthcare in LMICs. This initiative involves supporting governments to expand access to AI-enabled point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) and other digitally enabled innovations that broaden capacity for risk assessment and clinical decision-making in the antenatal and intrapartum period. The Senior Program Manager (SPM) will support this vision by driving the introduction of innovations that are ready for deployment and creating a global ecosystem for sustaining the use of these innovations in quality maternal care.

The Senior Program Manager (SPM) will be expected to manage a complex program to ensure successful implementation of activities by all relevant teams and partners. The SPM will also be expected to proactively set global-level project goals and drive strategy development around this important technology area. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, strategy, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, be comfortable managing a range of strategic and operational priorities and thrive in a dynamic environment. The person in this role will also serve as an organizational lead for the relevant technology areas and should maintain an in-depth understanding of the technical difficulties that impact the sector.

This position will report to the Associate Director, Women’s and Newborn Health and manage a team of at least one country support manager in the relevant project focal countries. This position will also oversee work across CHAI's country teams, AI Team, and Market Shaping Cluster. This position will also involve frequent strategic engagement with internal and external global partners including the relevant project donor.

The individual in this role may be based in a CHAI program country in Africa or another geography that overlaps with US and Africa time zones where they have preexisting work authorization. This individual must be willing to travel frequently to project countries or elsewhere, as well as to work across time zones with a geographically dispersed team.

Key responsibilities are described below. The exact split of time between different responsibilities may vary depending on the stage of the program, and responsibilities may change over time as the program evolves.

Strategic Program Leadership (40%)

Drive the process to develop a product access and program implementation strategy for AI POCUS in collaboration with the relevant project teams and WNH leadership
Cultivate technical expertise on AI-enabled POCUS and maternal and newborn health as needed to function as the dedicated product access strategy lead
Support the translation of CHAI’s market shaping and implementation strategy into practical, achievable project activities in partnership with project teams
Leverage program data and insights to constantly monitor strategy, identify threats and opportunities, and adapt the program as needed in consultation with manager
Drive strategic discussions and knowledge-sharing as relevant, including identifying linkages with other CHAI work and ensuring project plans are integrated with other team priorities

Project Management (40%)

Oversee work planning deploy sound project management skills to ensure quality, timely execution of project activities across project teams, identifying and mitigating risks where needed
Identify the need for and provide surge support across program activities as needed, including supporting assessment activities, the global platform, in-country implementation, and other activities as needed
Manage day-to-day engagement with donors to ensure ongoing alignment
Ensure the appropriate use of program resources, including supporting financial management and advising on resource trade-offs
Track progress against milestones, proactively identifying and mitigating risks
Lead the preparation of donor reports and funding approval processes
Proactively identify opportunities for better ways of working and sharing information across the project and develop processes to support the outcomes

Stakeholder and Relationship Management (20%)

Serve as a point of contact and for project partners (research partners, subgrantees, other CHAI teams, etc.) on POCUS and project work and cultivate a strong working relationship
Represent CHAI in global technical working groups and coordination meetings related to AI-enabled POCUS and maternal and newborn health, elevating CHAI’s role in the sector
Shape materials, deliverables, and key messages for senior internal and external stakeholders
Model CHAI's values and actively contribute to team culture-building initiatives, including Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion efforts
Master's degree in public health, medicine, business administration, public policy, science or a related field
Seven or more years of experience in a demanding, fast-paced environment (such as management consulting, global health or investment banking), with a record of growing responsibility
Experience owning product access strategy development including market shaping, health system strengthening, and product introduction
Track record of independently managing complex, multi-workstream projects through the full cycle, including planning, budgeting, execution, monitoring and close out, with minimal supervision
Experience working with governments and health systems in LMICs, including navigating complex government processes and influencing decisions
Experience developing and managing project budgets and grant resources, ensuring resources are aligned to program goals
Exceptional relationship and diplomatic skills, including managing senior, politically sensitive relationships with ministries, donors and implementing partners, and resolving conflict to reach shared results
Experience managing and developing staff, ideally including mid-level staff, and building cohesive, high-performing teams
Ability to set and carry out a coherent program strategy amid ambiguity, juggling multiple priorities and adapting calmly to shifting timelines
Ability to support strong analytical deliverables and use data to diagnose problems, inform strategy and track progress
Excellent written and verbal communication, including turning complex information into clear recommendations and polished materials (PowerPoint, Word) for government, donor, and other senior audiences
Comfortable using AI tools in daily work, understands the opportunities and threats of its use, and is interested in how AI-enabled technologies can strengthen health systems
Self-motivated and effective in a geographically dispersed, matrixed team across time zones and cultures
Strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to CHAI's mission and to diversity, equity, and inclusion
Technical knowledge of maternal and newborn health, imaging technology, medical device regulation, and related topics are strong advantages

Sargent & Lundy is seeking a Project Manager to support nuclear power projects at Brunswick Nuclear Station. This position will lead the planning, coordination, execution, control, and closeout of complex nuclear projects from initiation through completion.

Requirements

The successful candidate will serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects and will coordinate multidisciplinary engineering, project controls, procurement, construction, testing, operations, maintenance, quality, and client stakeholders. The role requires strong project leadership, disciplined execution, and the ability to deliver work safely, accurately, and in accordance with applicable station, client, regulatory, and quality requirements. As a Project Manager, you will:

Lead assigned nuclear projects through planning, engineering, procurement, implementation, testing, turnover, and closeout.
Establish and maintain project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, execution strategies, and performance objectives.
Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams and maintain alignment among engineering, construction, operations, maintenance, testing, procurement, quality, and project-controls organizations.
Serve as the primary client and station point of contact for project matters.
Develop and maintain project work plans, integrated schedules, milestone plans, risk registers, action-item logs, decision logs, and status reports.
Monitor project cost, schedule, resource loading, commitments, forecasts, changes, and performance trends.
Lead project meetings, readiness reviews, design reviews, planning sessions, walkdowns, and execution coordination meetings.
Identify project risks, constraints, interfaces, and emerging issues; develop mitigation strategies and escalate matters when appropriate.
Manage scope development and change control, including evaluation of impacts to cost, schedule, quality, safety, configuration, and implementation readiness.
Coordinate vendor, contractor, and supplier interfaces, including technical deliverables, procurement activities, field support, and performance follow-up.
Support work-order development, outage planning, construction planning, startup, testing, turnover, and closeout activities as applicable to the assigned project.
Ensure project deliverables are complete, technically accurate, properly reviewed, and issued in accordance with client and Sargent & Lundy requirements.
Promote nuclear safety, quality assurance, configuration control, human performance, and procedural adherence throughout project execution.
Maintain effective communication with station leadership, client project managers, responsible engineers, discipline leads, suppliers, contractors, and field personnel.
Support lessons learned, continuous improvement, and knowledge transfer across project teams.

Work Environment

This position is based on a hybrid work schedule supporting Brunswick Nuclear Station in Southport, NC and will require on-site support 2-4 days a week. The role may require occasional travel to Sargent & Lundy offices, client locations, vendor facilities, or other project sites. Additional hours or outage-period support may be required based on project and station needs.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

E Ssential Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, project management, business, or a related technical field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
10 or more years of applicable experience in nuclear power, utility, engineering, construction, project management, or a related technical environment.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary project teams with increasing responsibility.
Experience managing project scope, cost, schedule, risk, resources, contracts, and client communication.
Experience supporting projects in an operating nuclear plant or other highly regulated industrial environment.
Strong written, verbal, organizational, analytical, and presentation skills.
Ability to interpret engineering documents, specifications, procedures, schedules, estimates, procurement documents, and project reports.
Ability to work effectively with client personnel, station organizations, engineering disciplines, contractors, vendors, and field teams.
Ability to obtain and maintain access to a nuclear facility, subject to client and site requirements.
Ability to work on site at Brunswick Nuclear Station and support planned outages, extended planning periods, and time-sensitive project milestones as needed.

Valued But Not Required Skills And Experience

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project-management credential.
Experience with nuclear plant modifications, engineering changes, work management, outage execution, construction, commissioning, testing, turnover, or closeout.
Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, cost-control systems, earned-value concepts, or similar project-controls tools.
Familiarity with nuclear quality-assurance programs, Appendix B, NQA-1, configuration management, design control, and utility-specific project procedures.
Experience coordinating vendor engineering, procurement, installation, post-modification testing, and turnover documentation.
Prior experience at Brunswick Nuclear Station or another boiling-water reactor facility.
Familiarity with station work-management systems, outage planning processes, and project phase-gate reviews.

new_jobs.description:
Client-Side Project Manager - ADP Lyric

About enhanceHCM

enhanceHCM is a national professional services firm specializing in M&A Strategic HCM Consulting, Interim HR and Payroll Support, Project Management, Systems Implementation, and Tax Registration Support across a wide range of industries. Focused on optimizing Human Capital Management, we partner with middle market and Fortune 1000 organizations, private equity firms, and their portfolio companies to deliver high-impact solutions in complex, fast-paced environments.
Our team brings decades of hands-on experience and deep functional expertise to every engagement, with a proven track record of delivering trusted, results-driven outcomes. We are actively seeking experienced professionals with expertise in Strategic HR, Payroll, Project Management, Systems Implementation, and Human Capital M&A. Ideal candidates are relationship-driven, highly organized, and thrive in solving complex business challenges with confidence and precision

The Opportunity

We're looking for a driven, strategic, and detail-oriented Lyric Implementation Project/Program Manager to join our team. In this role, you'll serve as the client-side project leader throughout the end-to-end implementation lifecycle, providing the governance, structure, and leadership necessary to drive successful enterprise HCM implementations.
Acting as an extension of the client's team and a strategic partner to the software vendor, you'll serve as the liaison between both parties, ensuring alignment on project objectives, timelines, deliverables, and measures of success. You'll advocate for the client's business priorities while fostering a collaborative vendor relationship that supports shared accountability, effective decision-making, and successful implementation outcomes.
This role requires more than traditional project coordination. You'll lead project governance, guide cross-functional teams, manage risks and escalations, and bring clarity and direction to complex implementation environments, including those involving API integrations and technical dependencies. Your ability to influence stakeholders, resolve challenges, and maintain momentum will be critical to delivering successful outcomes for both the client and the vendor.
This is a remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced project or program manager who thrives in a dynamic, client-facing environment and brings a strong understanding of enterprise HCM implementations, stakeholder leadership, and vendor-client partnership management.
What You'll Do

Own Project Governance: Establish and lead project governance throughout all phases of the Lyric implementation lifecycle, including project planning, milestones, deliverables, decision-making, risk management, issue resolution, and accountability.
Lead End-to-End Implementations: Provide client-side project leadership from initiation and planning through execution, testing, deployment, go-live, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with established project objectives and success measures.
Serve as the Client's Advocate: Act as an extension of the client's team, representing its business priorities, operational requirements, and strategic objectives while ensuring concerns are addressed and commitments are met.
Partner Strategically with the Vendor: Serve as the primary liaison between the client and software vendor, fostering a collaborative partnership, aligning expectations, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining shared accountability for implementation success.
Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Coordinate and guide client stakeholders, vendor resources, technical teams, and functional subject matter experts across multiple workstreams, ensuring clear ownership, effective collaboration, and timely execution.
Oversee Technical Dependencies and Integrations: Coordinate API integrations, data interfaces, and other technical dependencies within the HCM implementation, partnering with technical teams to identify risks, manage interdependencies, and drive resolution.
Manage Risks, Issues, and Escalations: Proactively identify project risks, remove roadblocks, manage scope and timeline impacts, and lead de-escalation efforts when challenges arise. Facilitate productive conversations that restore alignment and keep projects moving forward.
Drive Stakeholder Communication and Alignment: Establish clear communication channels, facilitate project status meetings and governance forums, communicate project health and risks, and ensure stakeholders have the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.
Monitor Project Performance and Success Measures: Track progress against milestones, scope, budget, deliverables, and agreed-upon success criteria, providing visibility into project performance and driving corrective action when needed.
Build Trusted Client Relationships: Develop strong relationships with client leadership, project teams, and vendor partners through proactive communication, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on client experience and successful outcomes.
Ensure Mutual Project Success: Balance client advocacy with a collaborative vendor partnership, ensuring the implementation delivers meaningful business value for the client while supporting a productive, successful engagement for all parties.

What You Bring

Proven experience leading enterprise-level HCM software implementations, preferably with hands-on project or program management experience supporting ADP Lyric implementations from planning through go-live and stabilization.
Strong understanding of API integrations, system interfaces, and technical dependencies within complex HCM implementations, with the ability to coordinate technical teams, manage integration risks, and drive resolution.
Demonstrated expertise in project governance, including project planning, milestone management, risk and issue oversight, dependency tracking, stakeholder accountability, and executive-level reporting.
Experience serving as a client-side project or program manager, acting as a liaison between the client and software vendor, advocating for client objectives while building a strategic, collaborative vendor partnership.
Ability to lead cross-functional project teams, align business and technical stakeholders, coordinate multiple workstreams, and maintain momentum throughout complex, enterprise-level implementations.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate challenges, assess project risks, and drive timely resolution.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, manage expectations, and establish credibility across executive leadership, client teams, vendor partners, and internal project teams.
Advanced relationship management skills, including the ability to balance client advocacy with vendor collaboration, navigate competing priorities, and maintain productive partnerships throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Skilled in de-escalation, conflict resolution, and stakeholder alignment, with the ability to manage challenging situations, facilitate difficult conversations, and drive productive, outcome-focused resolutions.
Demonstrated ability to create structure, clarity, and alignment across multiple stakeholders in complex, fast-moving environments while maintaining accountability for project outcomes.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, workstreams, and dependencies while maintaining visibility into project health, progress, and deliverables.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive approach to identifying risks, driving solutions, enforcing governance, and keeping projects moving forward.
Comfortable leading independently and collaboratively in fast-paced, evolving settings, with the leadership presence and judgment to provide direction and confidence throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent) is a plus.

Why enhanceHCM?

At enhanceHCM, we strive for excellence in every engagement and seek solution-driven professionals who thrive on making an impact. As a Lyric Implementation Project Manager, you'll play a key role as an individual contributor who leads with purpose - guiding clients, coordinating project teams, and aligning seamlessly with vendors and partners to ensure unified, successful outcomes.
We foster a collaborative culture that values proactive thinking, professional growth, and balance. With a flexible remote environment and a team of high-performing experts by your side, you'll have the support and freedom to do your best work-while building a career that reflects your strengths and aspirations.
