Location: Remote: California.

Location Status: Requires 25%-50% travel, including occasional overnight travel. Work will be primarily performed remotely from home office. Occasional travel to and work from other Race offices or off-site locations may be required.

Free Fiber Internet Service

Comp: $71,000-$79,000 USD per year

Who We Are:

We're more than a fiber internet provider, we're your neighbors, committed to connecting California communities since 1994. At Race, relationships matter as much as speed. We combine cutting-edge technology with a genuine, people-first approach that makes every interaction feel personal. Our team operates like family: collaborative, supportive, and dedicated to making a real difference. When you join Race, you're not just accepting a job, you're becoming part of a team that values integrity, celebrates wins together and believes that meaningful work happens when great people connect with great purpose.

Position Impact:

The Sales Training Program Manager is responsible for owning, managing, and continuously improving the company's sales training infrastructure to drive consistent, high-level performance across inside sales and door-to-door (D2D) sales channels, including contractor teams. This role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of onboarding programs, manages and optimizes the LMS platform (Articulate 360), and develops and scales training frameworks such as train-the-trainer models for both internal teams and external partners. The position plays a key role in enabling sales effectiveness by designing, coordinating, and delivering training across diverse sales environments, including inside sales and field-based D2D teams. The Manager provides hands-on coaching to sales representatives and frontline leadership, reinforcing core selling skills, improving execution, and ensuring alignment with company standards, messaging, and customer experience expectations.

Operating with a high level of ownership, this role partners cross-functionally with Sales Leadership, Operations, Sales Training, and contractor teams to establish program priorities, align training initiatives with business objectives, monitor effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement. The role is accountable for training program consistency, execution, and measurable impact on sales performance, onboarding effectiveness, and overall business outcomes. The Sales Training Program Manager leads the ongoing evolution of a scalable, high-impact sales training ecosystem that supports business growth and consistent execution across markets and sales channels.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience:

Eligibility for US Employment without sponsorship
Minimum of 18 years of age
Associate degree (A.A.) or equivalent education in a related field of study preferred
High School Diploma or GED or equivalent combination of education and experience is required
A valid driver's license, subject to successful verification through a DMV check, is mandatory
Ability to travel to multiple work sites and maintain a flexible schedule based on the needs of the Sales organization, including evenings, overnight, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required
3-5 years of experience in sales, sales training, enablement, or coaching roles, with increasing responsibility in training program ownership, development, implementation, or optimization
Proven success supporting both inside sales (phone-based) and outside sales (field or door-to-door) environments, including experience working with or training contractor teams
Demonstrated ability to own, manage, and continuously improve training programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Strong public speaking, presentation, and facilitation skills with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences, including frontline teams and leadership
Experience developing structured training content, onboarding programs, and instructional materials that drive measurable performance outcomes
Proficiency with Salesforce, LMS platforms (Articulate 360 preferred), sales enablement tools, and data/reporting dashboards (e.g., SalesRabbit or similar)
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable training improvements and measurable business results
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
Demonstrated ability to manage training program priorities, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across multiple sales channels
Experience establishing program success metrics, evaluating training effectiveness, and using performance data to guide continuous improvement
Experience in telecommunications or other rapid-growth, performance-driven industries strongly preferred
The ability to effectively communicate in English, including speaking, reading, writing, and comprehension, as necessary for effective job performance and workplace communication
Bilingual communication skills are considered a plus, particularly when serving diverse communities

Skills:

Proficient use of MS Office applications including Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; teleconferencing applications
Functional use of common office equipment, computers, and office software

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Training Strategy & Program Ownership

Own the strategy, ongoing management, and continuous improvement of sales training programs to ensure alignment with business goals, sales strategy, and customer experience standards
Identify performance gaps across inside sales, D2D, and contractor teams and develop targeted, scalable training solutions
Align training initiatives with sales campaigns, promotions, and go-to-market priorities
Track, measure, and report on training effectiveness and overall business impact
Establish program objectives, success measures, and priorities to ensure training initiatives deliver measurable business results
Manage training program timelines, resources, and deliverables to support consistent execution across sales channels
Own and maintain centralized storage and organization of training records, materials, completion data, and program documentation to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and reliable reporting across sales channels

Training Program Design & Delivery

Design and implement structured training programs for inside sales, field (D2D), and contractor teams, including onboarding, skills development, and advanced selling techniques
Develop engaging curriculum covering customer discovery, objection handling, product knowledge, CRM utilization, and sales strategy
Facilitate recurring training sessions to reinforce core competencies and introduce new sales concepts
Evaluate and optimize training content, delivery methods, and learning experiences based on participant feedback, performance data, and evolving business needs
Ensure training programs are scalable, repeatable, and consistently delivered across regions and sales channels

Sales Onboarding

Own the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires across inside sales, field teams, and contractor channels to ensure consistent ramp and readiness
Deliver blended learning experiences including classroom, virtual, and hands-on field training
Coordinate onboarding schedules in alignment with hiring plans, contractor onboarding, and business needs
Define and monitor onboarding milestones and readiness criteria to improve time-to-productivity and ensure consistent new-hire preparation across channels

Ongoing Development & Coaching

Facilitate ongoing workshops, role-playing sessions, and refresher training to support continuous skill development
Implement and scale a train-the-trainer model to enable Sales Managers and contractor leaders to reinforce coaching in the field
Maintain and continuously improve training resources including scripts, playbooks, and best-practice guides
Develop and maintain a structured training calendar and ongoing development roadmap aligned with sales performance needs and business priorities
Assess the effectiveness of ongoing development initiatives and recommend enhancements to strengthen skill adoption and retention

Field Training & Market Support

Travel to regional markets to support new territory launches and provide in-field coaching for D2D and contractor sales teams
Shadow sales representatives and provide real-time coaching and performance feedback
Tailor training support based on local market dynamics, team performance, and contractor needs
Identify recurring field performance trends and translate findings into program enhancements, standardized resources, and targeted training interventions

Performance Monitoring & Program Effectiveness

Analyze sales performance data to identify trends, skill gaps, and training opportunities across channels
Partner with Sales Managers, Supervisors, and L&D to support development plans for underperforming team members
Deliver targeted coaching interventions to improve individual and team performance
Establish and monitor program-level performance metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, knowledge retention, skill application, and impact on sales outcomes
Use performance insights and stakeholder feedback to recommend program adjustments and prioritize continuous improvement initiatives
Communicate program performance, progress against objectives, and improvement opportunities to relevant stakeholders

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment

Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, HR, L&D, and Operations to ensure training content reflects current campaigns, messaging, and business priorities
Partner with internal stakeholders to track training completion, ensure compliance, and support onboarding and reporting processes
Coordinate with contractor partners to ensure consistent training standards and execution
Serve as the primary program owner and point of coordination for sales training initiatives, aligning stakeholders on program priorities, deliverables, and outcomes
Drive cross-functional alignment to ensure training programs remain current, consistent, and responsive to changes in products, processes, sales strategy, and market needs

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Time-to-productivity for new hires across inside sales, D2D, and contractor channels
Training completion, adoption, and engagement rates
Measurable improvement in sales performance following training interventions
Coaching effectiveness and impact on individual and team performance
Consistency of training execution across regions and contractor teams
Achievement of established training program objectives, milestones, and deliverables
Improvement in knowledge retention, skill application, and post-training performance outcomes
Training program effectiveness and return on investment, where measurable

Vehicle Maintenance and Travel:

Maintains vehicle/equipment pre-op/post-op to be prepared to perform required duties
Maintains a clean driving record as defined by the current fleet insurance underwriter
Requires 25%-50% travel, including occasional overnight travel

Safety Protocols:

Adheres to safety protocols and guidelines outlined in the Race employee handbook and job description to promote a safe work environment

Join a tight-knit crew—no faceless corporation vibes here
Growth potential: promotions and new challenges are part of our DNA

Company Description
EHN Consulting LLC is a professional services firm that provides strategic planning and insights to food and beverage and dairy industries. The company focuses on delivering reliable, efficient, and cost-effective solutions that help organizations meet complex operational and strategic goals. EHN Consulting LLC emphasizes collaboration, clear communication, and accountability in all client engagements. Team members work in a flexible, largely remote environment while maintaining high standards of performance and client service.

Job description;

An Idaho based dairy manufacturing plant owned by based in Southern Idaho is developing a 35-acre greenfield site. They seek an experienced dairy or food industry leader to coordinate the development and launch of a new dairy plant. The individual does not need to be proficient in every aspect described below. They will be able to bring in specialist expertise and consultants as needed. The essential capability is to lead people, manage multiple tasks and workstreams concurrently, establish priorities, and coordinate partners to keep the project moving forward.
Working closely with an engaged ownership group and advisors, the Project Leader will guide the business through financing, customer commitments, engineering, construction, equipment installation, commissioning, and commercial startup. The role carries significant responsibility and autonomy, with major commitments subject to ownership approval.

Timing and location;

The role may commence part time in the next few months, with the goal of transitioning to full-time work and assuming project leadership in January 2027 following a structured handover. We expect the assignment to last at least 18 months. Following commissioning, there is potential to transition into a plant leadership position, such as Operations, General Manager or CEO, subject to mutual agreement and ownership approval.
The role may be remote, with travel to the site, and substantial on-site involvement as construction, commissioning, and startup progress. Annual full-time salary: $200,000. Travel and per diem expenses will be paid for with approval. Compensation for any initial part-time period will be agreed separately.

Key Responsibilities;

Lead the business and project.
Translate ownership objectives into an integrated execution plan. Coordinate concurrent workstreams, assign accountability, drive timely decisions, manage risks and contingencies, and report clearly on progress, spending, and decisions requiring approval. Serve as the principal management contact for project partners.
Build the commercial foundation.
Develop customer relationships and secure multi-year offtake agreements. Align product specifications, quality, volumes, pricing, launch timing, and capacity commitments with the plant design, production plans, and financial projections.
Coordinate financing and financial planning.
Oversee and refine the business plan, pro forma, budgets, cash requirements, and cost-to-completion forecasts with financial advisers. Work with ownership and advisors to secure equity investors, coordinate investor and lender due diligence, and secure financing. Pursue appropriate grants, loan guarantees, tax credits, and incentives with USDA, State of Idaho, and local Municipality.
Oversee engineering construction and equipment.
Lead the owner’s relationship with engineers, contractors, suppliers, and consultants. Oversee and provide feedback to engineers on facility design, equipment procurement and installation, utilities, automation, and testing. Track cost, schedule, quality, safety, contractor performance, and changes requiring approval.

Additional Responsibilities;

Prepare the organization for operations.
 Assist in search and hiring of operations manager who will coordinate milk supply, ingredients, packaging, cold storage, logistics, maintenance, staffing, training, and operating systems. Build the initial team and ensure food safety, quality, production planning, customer approvals, and traceability requirements are addressed.
Lead commissioning and commercial startup.
Coordinate with engineering, equipment suppliers, operations, quality, and maintenance through equipment testing, sanitation validation, product trials, troubleshooting, and the production ramp. Establish readiness and acceptance criteria and track capacity, yield, quality, cost, safety, and efficiency.
Coordinate permitting and compliance.
Work with the local Municipality , State of Idaho, USDA, and other agencies on permits and project requirements. Engage legal and technical advisers for environmental, wastewater, food safety, workplace safety, contracts, insurance, and other compliance matters.

Essential Qualifications;   

At least 10 years of relevant dairy or food industry experience, with sound understanding of dairy processing and plant operations.
·      Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects, manage multiple priorities concurrently, and coordinate internal teams, outside specialists, and consultants.
·      Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to oversee budgets and financial models, assess assumptions, and recognize when specialist advice is needed.
·      Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to build productive relationships with owners, customers, investors, lenders, engineers, contractors, and agencies.
·      Strong organizational skills, practical problem solving, and clear accountability for decisions and follow-through.
·      Proficiency with Microsoft, Google, and Adobe platforms for communication, documentation, and project coordination. Engagement with AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT beneficial.
·      Willingness to travel and maintain substantial on-site involvement during construction, commissioning, and startup.

Helpful Experience

Experience with dairy or food manufacturing business is preferred. Other useful experience includes capital projects or greenfield development; customer offtake agreements; equity and debt financing; grants and incentives; engineering and construction oversight; and commissioning or operating-team development. Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every one of these areas.

Project Manager II - Implementation Project Manager

Location: Remote within Wisconsin

Employment Type: Contract

Anticipated Start: Late November 2026

Initial Duration: Through June 30, 2027, with potential for extension

Schedule: Must be available during core Central Time business hours

Position Overview

The Wisconsin Department of Children and Families (DCF) is seeking an experienced Implementation Project Manager to support a large-scale modernization initiative focused on implementing a new case management system.
This position will oversee and coordinate implementation activities leading up to and throughout pilot and system rollout. The Implementation Project Manager will work across project management, organizational change management (OCM), training, technical teams, implementation leadership, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure the organization is prepared for each stage of implementation.
This role is particularly focused on implementation planning, organizational readiness, stakeholder coordination, communications, training readiness, pilot execution, and phased system rollout. The Project Manager will oversee day-to-day implementation activities, track progress and issues, coordinate dependencies across teams, and help ensure the organization is prepared to transition from the existing environment to the modernized system.
Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive implementation and communication plans for a large-scale system modernization initiative.
* Oversee implementation activities leading up to and during pilot, go-live, and phased regional system rollouts.
* Coordinate functional and technical implementation activities across project teams, vendors, and DCF stakeholders.
* Partner closely with Project Management, Organizational Change Management, Training, and implementation leadership to ensure organizational readiness.
* Track implementation activities, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and overall progress.
* Coordinate with project leadership to resolve implementation issues within required timeframes.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting regarding implementation progress, readiness, risks, and potential issues.
* Develop and maintain acceptance and readiness criteria for major implementation milestones, including:
○ UAT to pilot
○ Pilot to system rollout
○ Subsequent regional rollout phases
* Coordinate state-level activities required to maintain alignment between legacy systems and the modernized system during pilot and rollout.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings between business, technical, OCM, training, vendor, and project teams.
* Coordinate with implementation vendors to ensure required hardware and software are available prior to scheduled go-live dates.
* Support planning for periods in which legacy and new systems may operate simultaneously.
* Partner with Training and Organizational Change Management teams to confirm required training and communications are completed prior to implementation.
* Ensure project teams and stakeholders are informed of upcoming implementation activities, timelines, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate activities related to system rollout, site support, user readiness, user account provisioning, and defect/issue reporting.
* Identify potential implementation challenges and recommend appropriate process, policy, or procedural changes when necessary.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
Required Qualifications

Candidates should have 11+ years of experience in:
* Project management.
* Developing and implementing project implementation plans and communication plans.
* Building and maintaining collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholder groups.
Candidates should also have demonstrated experience with:
* Large-scale system implementations and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Coordinating complex implementation activities across multiple project teams and stakeholder groups.
* Organizational change, implementation readiness, and training efforts.
* Project leadership and management.
* Managing competing priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Written and verbal communication, including developing and delivering presentations to stakeholders.
* Facilitating cross-functional meetings and driving activities toward implementation milestones.
Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting federal or state government programs.
* Federal Child Support Program experience.
* Experience implementing or modernizing large-scale case management systems.
* Experience working alongside Organizational Change Management, training, technical, and implementation teams.
* Experience supporting phased implementations involving pilot programs and regional rollouts.
Project Environment

This position will support the Child Support Modernization Project, which is implementing a new case management system. The Implementation Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders and will be responsible for overseeing and tracking implementation progress, coordinating day-to-day activities, and ensuring teams remain aligned throughout pilot and rollout.
The position requires someone who can operate across both the business and technical sides of an implementation. The individual will not simply maintain a project plan. They will actively coordinate teams, surface and resolve implementation issues, manage readiness activities, and ensure the appropriate pieces are in place for successful go-live and rollout.
Remote Work Requirements

* Candidates must currently reside in Wisconsin or be willing to relocate to Wisconsin within 30 days of the start date at their own expense.
* The position is approximately 90-100% remote, although occasional onsite work may be required with appropriate notice.
* Candidates must be physically located within the United States, and work cannot be performed outside the U.S.
* Candidates must be available during required Central Time business hours.
* The selected candidate will be responsible for providing their own computer equipment, reliable internet connection, camera, and headset for remote work.
* No regular on-call or weekend coverage is required.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Water Services
new_jobs.description:
Job description

Reporting to the Manager of Public Engagement & Connection Services, the Program Manager – Water Systems is responsible for the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of programs that enhance the efficiency, accountability, reliability, and sustainability of CK PUC drinking water distribution systems.

The position leads programs to quantify and manage accounted-for and unaccounted-for water through water audits, water loss analysis, optimized flushing practices, leak detection, and identification of unauthorized water use. Using operational data, technology, performance measures, regulatory guidance, and industry best practices, the Program Manager identifies opportunities to reduce water loss, improve distribution system performance, support infrastructure planning, and promote the efficient use of treated drinking water.

Working collaboratively with internal departments, Entegrus, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, Source Protection Authorities, and other stakeholders, the position provides technical expertise, program oversight, policy development, budget monitoring, and recommendations to management and Commission. The position also supports CK PUC's source-to-tap approach to drinking water management through source water protection, regulatory best practices, water conservation, system performance, and public education. Ontario identifies source protection as the first step in its multi-barrier, source-to-tap drinking water protection framework.

Essential responsibilities

Demonstrate Chatham-Kent’s core values and competencies
Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive water accountability program, including water audits to quantify accounted-for and unaccounted-for water, identify system losses, establish performance targets, and support water loss reduction initiatives.
Develop and oversee leak detection, unauthorized water use investigations, flushing optimization, and related programs that improve distribution system efficiency, reliability, and accountability.
Evaluate flushing practices and seasonal programs to minimize unnecessary discharge of treated water while maintaining water quality requirements, including appropriate flushing of dead-end watermains.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, key performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting tools to measure water loss, flushing volumes, leak detection, water use, system efficiency, and overall program performance.
Analyze operational, infrastructure, consumption, and financial data to identify trends and improvement opportunities and prepare reports, business cases, recommendations, and presentations for management, Commissioners, and senior leadership.
Lead the implementation, administration, and optimization of technologies and software supporting water system performance, including leak detection, pressure and flow monitoring, smart metering (AMI/AMR), GIS, SCADA, data analytics, and related systems.
Research and evaluate emerging technologies, industry practices, and process improvements that enhance water accountability, operational efficiency, asset performance, and customer service.
Support asset management, watermain condition assessment, lifecycle planning, master planning, and infrastructure prioritization by incorporating system performance, condition, water loss, and operational data into decision-making.
Assist with operating and capital budget development, procurement, business cases, grant opportunities, and long-term program planning; monitor program, equipment, and related expenditures against approved budgets.
Develop and maintain policies, procedures, standards, service levels, and quality assurance practices supporting water accountability, conservation, flushing, leak detection, distribution system performance, and regulatory compliance.
Lead the review and integration of applicable MECP Drinking Water System Best Management Practices and industry standards into water system programs, risk management, performance measures, policies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support CK PUC's drinking water source protection responsibilities by collaborating with internal departments, Source Protection Authorities, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to identify and address risks to municipal drinking water sources and incorporate applicable source protection policies and best practices into water system planning and programs. Ontario's source protection framework uses locally developed, science-based plans to identify vulnerable drinking water areas, threats, and actions to protect municipal drinking water sources.
Build and maintain effective relationships with internal departments, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, industry partners, and other stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives related to water system performance and continuous improvement.
Serve as the primary liaison with Entegrus field personnel for water program activities, including equipment purchases and deployment, program delivery, contractor performance, and monitoring associated operating and capital expenditures.
Support public education and communications related to CK PUC drinking water systems, source water protection, water conservation, water loss, and system initiatives through the CK PUC website, social media, and other communication channels. Education and outreach are among the tools used in Ontario's source water protection framework.

Essential qualifications

Three-year post-secondary diploma or university degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, Engineering Technology, Applied Science, Environmental Studies, Water Resources, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of related education and experience.
Four (4) to six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in municipal water distribution, water/wastewater utilities, infrastructure management, engineering, asset management, water resources, or a related field.
Demonstrated knowledge of municipal drinking water and distribution systems, with experience in one or more of the following: water loss management, water auditing, leak detection, flushing programs, utility data analysis, infrastructure condition assessment, asset management, water conservation, or municipal program management.
Experience with program development, project coordination, performance measurement, data analysis, budget monitoring, and preparation of technical reports, policies, procedures, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, project management, and stakeholder relationship skills.
Strong computer skills with experience using data management, mapping, analytics, reporting, or water utility software applications.

Other qualifications

The following would be considered assets:
Ontario Water Distribution Operator Certification.
Certified Engineering Technologist (CET), Certified Technician (C.Tech.), Professional Engineer (P.Eng.), Project Management Professional (PMP), or related professional designation.
Experience with GIS, SCADA, hydraulic modelling, AMI/smart metering, pressure and flow monitoring, leak detection technologies, Power BI, and AWWA Water Audit Software.
Experience applying water loss control, drinking water best management practices, source water protection principles, or asset management practices.
Experience in a municipal government or public utility environment.
Experience developing policies, procedures, service levels, performance frameworks, procurement documentation, business cases, or grant and funding applications.

Certifications, memberships, licenses

Membership and registration with the Ontario Association of Certified Engineering Technicians and Technologists as a CET or with Professional Engineers Ontario as a P.Eng., or another relevant professional organization is preferred.

Work environment/hours of work

This position works both indoors and outdoors
This position is required to work weekday hours, with occasional evening hours

Driver’s licence/vehicle requirements

This position requires the successful candidate to have a valid class G Ontario driver’s licence; a driver’s abstract will be conducted by the Municipality of Chatham-Kent. An acceptable driver’s abstract will: be an original document and current (within the previous thirty (30) days); have no more than four (4) demerit points; have no more than two (2) convictions for the same offence; have no criminal code convictions; have no ‘non-medical or administrative’ license suspension in the preceding three (3) years. Because this position may be required to drive their own vehicle, a reliable vehicle is also required.

Essential physical and/or safety requirements

Walking: frequent walking to/from printers,meetings etc. Sometimes visiting treatment plants
Sitting: frequent sitting in primary office, meeting locations etc.
Hands: frequent fine finger dexterity (movement), mousing (keyboarding, mousing, data management, preparing reports, reviewing operational data)

En ProntoPaga, empresa que forma parte de Worldwide Payments (WWP) Services, holding tecnológico que impulsa el movimiento del dinero en Latinoamérica, desarrollamos soluciones de pago robustas, seguras y escalables para operar a nivel regional. Si te motiva trabajar en un entorno dinámico, inclusivo y con impacto real… ¡este es tu lugar!

Buscamos a un/a profesional con sólida experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, enfoque analítico, pensamiento crítico, autonomía en la gestión y capacidad para liderar iniciativas de principio a fin, promoviendo una cultura de seguridad alineada con los objetivos estratégicos de la organización.

Su principal propósito será fortalecer la gestión de los riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, ciberseguridad y tecnología mediante la definición, implementación y mejora continua de políticas, estándares, controles y mecanismos de supervisión, así como realizar una evaluación independiente de su cumplimiento por parte de las áreas responsables de la operación de los procesos y controles (primera línea de defensa).

El cargo tendrá un rol clave en la administración, mantenimiento y mejora continua del Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI), asegurando la conservación y evolución de las certificaciones ISO/IEC 27001 y PCI DSS existentes, además de contribuir al fortalecimiento del marco de gobierno de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad de la organización.

Asimismo, será responsable de promover una adecuada gestión de riesgos y cumplimiento normativo, asegurando el alineamiento de las prácticas de seguridad con los objetivos del negocio, las exigencias regulatorias, las obligaciones contractuales y las mejores prácticas internacionales.

Como función de segunda línea de defensa, deberá proporcionar supervisión, asesoría especializada y monitoreo independiente sobre la efectividad de los controles de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad, contribuyendo a la protección de los activos de información, los sistemas tecnológicos y los datos sensibles de la organización.

Su gestión deberá contribuir al fortalecimiento de la continuidad operacional, la resiliencia operacional y digital, la protección de la información financiera, comercial y personal, así como a mantener la confianza de clientes, socios estratégicos, organismos reguladores y demás partes interesadas, velando permanentemente por la confidencialidad, integridad y disponibilidad de la información.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?

Administrar, mantener y mejorar continuamente el Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI), asegurando su alineamiento con los requisitos de ISO/IEC 27001 y otros estándares aplicables.
Asegurar que las políticas, procedimientos, estándares y controles de Seguridad de la Información se mantengan actualizados, documentados y adecuadamente implementados en la organización.
Integrar los requisitos de seguridad de la información en procesos de negocio, operaciones y tecnología.
Identificar, evaluar y gestionar riesgos de Seguridad de la Información asociados a activos de información, procesos, proyectos, tecnologías y servicios críticos.
Liderar la coordinación de auditorías, evaluaciones de cumplimiento y procesos de certificación en materias de Seguridad de la Información, gestionando la atención de requerimientos, evidencias, observaciones y planes de remediación asociados.
Revisar y evaluar el cumplimiento de los estándares de configuración segura definidos por la organización.
Mantener actualizado el registro y análisis de riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, realizando seguimiento periódico a los planes de tratamiento y verificando la implementación efectiva de las medidas de mitigación definidas
Elaborar y reportar métricas e indicadores de desempeño, riegos y cumplimiento asociados a seguridad de la información.
Apoyar programas de capacitación, concientización y fortalecimiento de la cultura de seguridad de la información.
Responder cuestionarios de seguridad, due diligence y requerimientos de clientes de forma clara y oportuna.
Gestionar y supervisar los procesos relacionados con la gestión de identidades y accesos, velando por la aplicación de los principios de mínimo privilegio y segregación de funciones.
Promover buenas prácticas de protección de la información en toda la organización.
Gestionar riesgos de seguridad asociados a terceros.
Evaluar riesgos de seguridad en proyectos, nuevos desarrollos e implementaciones tecnológicas.
Elaborar reportes y presentaciones para instancias de gobierno ejecutivas y comités.
Generar nuevas iniciativas en ámbitos de seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad.
Colaborar con equipos técnicos, operacionales y de negocio para apoyar la mitigación de riesgos y la implementación de controles alineados con la estrategia de Seguridad de la Información.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos?

Formación

Profesional titulado(a) de Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería en Ciberseguridad, Ingeniería Civil Informática, Ingeniería en Sistemas o carrera afín.

Experiencia

Contar con al menos 5 años de experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, Ciberseguridad, Gestión de Riesgos Tecnológicos o funciones relacionadas.
Poseer al menos 3 años de experiencia en roles asociados a gobierno, riesgo, cumplimiento (GRC) o funciones de segunda línea de defensa.
Deseable experiencia en organizaciones reguladas del sector financiero, Fintech, medios de pago, seguros u otras industrias con altos requerimientos regulatorios.
Experiencia en cumplimiento normativos y regulatorios en seguridad de la información.
Experiencia en procesos de certificación, mantención o auditoría de ISO/IEC 27001 y/o PCI DSS.
Experiencia en evaluación de riesgos de terceros, proveedores y servicios externalizados.
Experiencia en gestión de riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, riesgos tecnológicos y riesgos de ciberseguridad.

Conocimientos

Conocimientos en gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM), segregación de funciones y controles de acceso.
Conocimientos de seguridad en entornos Cloud.
Conocimientos generales de tecnologías y plataformas de seguridad/ciberseguridad.

O(a) Project Manager será responsável por monitorar e controlar as diferentes etapas do fornecimento de equipamentos novos e/ou reparados. Principais Responsabilidades

•    Gerenciar projetos desde o recebimento do pedido de compra do cliente até a entrega final do produto e/ou serviço, adotando uma abordagem centrada no cliente e priorizando a segurança em todas as etapas.

•    Realizar o encerramento dos projetos e elaborar um resumo final para as partes interessadas da Flowserve, incluindo resultados financeiros e lições aprendidas.

Qualificações Obrigatórias

•    Experiência em Gestão de Projetos ou em posições relacionadas à gestão.

•    Inglês fluente.
•    Forte habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal, organização, planejamento e comunicação.
•    Conhecimento técnico em área relacionada ao escopo dos projetos.
•    Domínio de Microsoft Project, Word, Excel e Outlook.
•    Capacidade de atuar com foco no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades e objetivos, propondo soluções dentro do escopo do projeto ou identificando oportunidades de ampliação do escopo e do pedido de compra.

•    Capacidade de ler e interpretar desenhos mecânicos, esquemas, diagramas de tubulação e instrumentação (P&IDs), desenhos de layout, diagramas elétricos, de instrumentação e interligações.

Qualificações Desejáveis

IMILE PARA SERVICIOS DE ENTREGA-COLOMBIA S.A.S
Ubicación:
Guayabal, Medellín, Antioquia
Área:
Operaciones
Modalidad:
Presencial

¿Quiénes somos?

iMile Delivery es una empresa multinacional de tecnología logística, especializada en soluciones de logística para comercio electrónico, envíos internacionales y distribución de última milla.
Fundada en Dubái en 2017, iMile tiene presencia en mas de 30 países, cuenta con un equipo global de más de 20.000 colaboradores y más de 500 profesionales especializados en tecnología.

A través de plataformas tecnológicas propias y soluciones digitales, conectamos a empresas, plataformas de comercio electrónico y consumidores, ofreciendo servicios logísticos eficientes e innovadores. Como parte de nuestro crecimiento en Colombia, buscamos talento con pensamiento analítico, curiosidad y ganas de aprender para unirse a nuestro equipo de Operaciones en Medellín.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Apoyar el análisis y seguimiento de los datos operativos de nuestra red logística, garantizando información precisa y oportuna para mejorar la eficiencia de nuestras operaciones y facilitar la toma de decisiones.

Responsabilidades principales Gestión de datos:
Recopilar, organizar, actualizar y validar bases de datos relacionadas con guías, entregas, estaciones y proveedores logísticos.
Elaboración de reportes:
Preparar informes diarios, semanales y mensuales utilizando Excel, incluyendo volúmenes de operación, tasas de entrega y tiempos de distribución.
Seguimiento de indicadores:
Monitorear KPIs operativos como entregas a tiempo (OTD), cumplimiento de SLA, guías pendientes y paquetes sin actualización.
Análisis de desempeño:
Comparar resultados entre estaciones, proveedores y zonas de distribución, identificando desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Visualización de información:
Elaborar tablas dinámicas, gráficos y reportes que permitan interpretar fácilmente los resultados operativos.
Mejora de procesos:
Apoyar la optimización y automatización de reportes y procesos de gestión de datos.

¿Qué buscamos? Requisitos indispensables:

Estudiantes de último semestre o recién graduados de Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería Industrial, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Tecnología de la Información o carreras afines.
Buen manejo de Microsoft Excel: fórmulas, filtros, funciones de búsqueda y tablas dinámicas.
Capacidad de razonamiento lógico y análisis de información.
Atención al detalle, organización y compromiso con la calidad de los datos.
Capacidad de aprendizaje autónomo y resolución de problemas.
Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en Medellín, de acuerdo con la jornada establecida para el cargo.

Conocimientos deseables (no excluyentes):

Conocimientos básicos de Python, SQL o Power BI.
Experiencia académica en limpieza de datos, automatización o elaboración de reportes.
Interés por el comercio electrónico, la logística y la cadena de suministro.
Conocimientos de inglés.

¡Queremos conocerte!

new_jobs.description:
REVENUE OPERATIONS ANALYST

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Revenue Operations Analyst supports Industrial Networking Solutions (INS) through accurate reporting, business analysis, and customer data enrichment. Reporting to the Manager of Revenue Operations, this role balances reporting and analysis with hands-on data quality work across the lead-to-booking process. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and able to explain the story behind the data, its business implications, and potential next steps.

Location

INS HQ - Richardson, TX office
Full-time | 100% on site

Key Responsibilities

Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports covering sales, bookings, gross profit, pipeline, customer purchasing history, and team activity.
Run, maintain, and help develop reports and saved searches in company systems; validate filters, data relationships, and results with guidance as needed.
Combine and reconcile data from multiple reports, investigate discrepancies, and document definitions and assumptions to support accurate reporting.
Analyze trends and exceptions, explain what the data means for the business, and communicate potential implications and recommended next steps to support sales visibility and operational improvement.
Research and enrich lead and customer records, including company details, headquarters, customer type, vertical market, and lead source.
Identify duplicate, incomplete, or inconsistent records and support cleanup and lead allocation using established RevOps rules.
Prepare account ownership and territory update files, support approved changes, and verify resulting account and transaction data.
Research customer segments and project activity to support sales initiatives, marketing case studies, and other business requests.
Document repeatable reporting and data quality procedures; use approved AI tools where appropriate and verify outputs against reliable sources.
Conduct periodic, randomly timed data integrity audits to verify accuracy across records and reports, surface anomalies, and support continuous data quality improvement.
Monitor data quality trends and proactively flag recurring issues, root causes, and remediation opportunities.
Support data governance by maintaining standardized definitions, business rules, and reporting logic across systems.
Validate data imports, updates, and account changes to ensure downstream reporting and system accuracy.

Qualifications & Skills

Required: Bachelor’s degree in business Analytics, Management Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
Required: 2–5 years of relevant experience in reporting, business analysis, revenue or sales operations, data quality, or a related field.
Highly preferred: NetSuite experience, particularly using reports and creating or modifying saved searches.
Required: Ability to work with spreadsheets and reporting tools to organize, review, and interpret data, with a willingness to learn new tools and techniques.
Required: Analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assignments and protect confidential information.
Required: Ability to translate data into a clear, compelling business narrative, explain findings to nontechnical audiences, and connect trends to practical implications and potential actions.
Strongly preferred: Practical experience using AI tools for research, data analysis, formula development, or process improvement, with demonstrated output validation and responsible data handling.
Preferred: Experience with Power Query, Power BI, SQL, or comparable reporting tools, and familiarity with sales or order-management processes.

Teamwork This position works closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Sales Support, Finance, Operations, and Marketing to clarify requests, resolve data questions, and deliver reliable information. The analyst follows established approval processes and escalates exceptions to the Manager of Revenue Operations.

Additional Requirements

Ability to work full-time onsite at the Richardson, TX office.
No travel is currently required.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Do not now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H-1B visa status)
Able to pass a criminal background check and drug screening.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.
Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.
Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.
If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.
The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.
Essential Functions

Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Payscale: $82,158.00 -$125,000.00

Bonus:
This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.
Benefits: Full-time:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

Description

Amazon's Global Procurement Organization is on a mission to transform how procurement works at Amazon scale. We build the technology that powers billions of dollars in purchasing decisions, and we're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help lead that transformation. In this role you'll help advance procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI increasingly supports and automates processes, with people orchestrating, verifying, and governing the work. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of technology, operations, and business strategy, where your work directly influences how Amazon procures and manages supplies at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional technology programs, from problem definition and design through build, launch, and iteration.
Manage roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across multiple engineering teams, proactively identifying risks and removing barriers to keep delivery on track.
Stand up and operate new delivery team structures for AI transformation initiatives, from team charter and composition through solutions running in production.
Drive architecture and design discussions, applying working knowledge of AI and AWS services to evaluate trade-offs and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sound.
Build the mechanisms the program depends on, including team and charter registries, playbooks for standing up new teams, and the feedback loop that carries learning between business areas.
Facilitate business and technical meetings, driving crisp decisions and ensuring the right people are in the room at the right time.
Communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes to a broad set of stakeholders, from engineering teams to Directors and VPs, through clear written narratives and verbal updates.
Independently identify and resolve structural blockers across teams and systems, including governance gaps, duplicated solutions, missing orchestration between existing tools, and unclear ownership.
Drive process improvements that increase the speed and quality of delivery across teams, streamlining mechanisms and eliminating unnecessary overhead.

Global Procurement Technology is the technical force behind Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We build the tools and systems that power procurement across Amazon — a function that forms the backbone of the company's operations. Our team sets the technology strategy for the business, driving its AI transformation by embedding intelligent automation, machine learning, and data-driven capabilities into every layer of the procurement experience. We partner closely with business teams to modernize systems, simplify complex workflows, and deliver scalable solutions that help Amazon procure smarter, faster, and more efficiently at global scale.

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
Experience in technical program management working directly with software engineering teams
Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
Experience working with AI systems, including large language models and agent-based workflows, strong enough to assess feasibility and challenge proposed designs

Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

Position Overview:

The Launch Manager is a dedicated, contract-based role embedded within a single brand's Core and Full Matrix launch teams.
Working in close partnership with the Brand Lead, the Launch Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of the launch: driving the launch plan, facilitating cross-functional governance, maintaining the Lx Playbook, and ensuring the team stays on track against the enterprise-wide Launch Excellence (Lx) roadmap - from Launch Initiation through Launch Planning & Execution and into Post-Launch.
This role does not set brand strategy; it operationalizes it, ensuring the full matrix team (Medical, Marketing, Market Access, Regulatory, and other functions) executes against a well-governed, transparent, and continuously updated launch plan.

Responsibilities:

Launch Governance & Team Enablement:
Support the Brand Lead in forming the Launch Core and Full Matrix Teams, ensuring appropriate 3M (Medical, Marketing, Market Access) representation.
Ensure all launch team members have access to, and are onboarded onto, the Lx Playbook and related Lx Resources.
Schedule and support facilitation of all launch project meetings and workshops, ensuring content is prepared in advance by the Full Matrix Team.
Establish and maintain core meeting cadences (Core Team, Full Matrix Team, and governance reviews) in line with the Lx Operational Guidance.
Provide reports and dashboards that support decision-making and cross-functional communication for the Brand Lead and Senior Leadership.
Support tangential launch-related projects in case someone is asked to manage something additional to the direct launch project (i.e. launch meeting, unblinding process, etc.) as requested by the brand / launch lead.

Launch Plan & Lx Playbook Management:
Own active, day-to-day management of the launch plan within the Lx Playbook, ensuring cross-functional deliverables, milestones, dates, and owners are accurate and continuously updated.
Track launch-critical, regulatory, and reimbursement milestone dates and validate them regularly with the Brand Lead and functional leads.
Monitor the Lx Playbook dashboard on a weekly basis, flagging at-risk items, interdependencies, and gaps proactively.
Lead launch scenario and mitigation planning in collaboration with the Core Team.
Provide ongoing navigation and utilization support to active team members.

Prioritization Grid & Promotional Materials Coordination:
Collaborate with all MLR (Marketing, Legal, Regulatory) stakeholders to build and maintain the Prioritization Grid as the single source of truth for cross-functional promotional materials.
Track status and progress of all launch materials, analyze the grid for gaps, and support the Promotional Materials Manager in day-to-day MLR review management, as needed.
Partner with Marketing Ops Manager to support prioritization and force-ranking of materials ahead of Reconciliation reviews to enable on-time 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' execution.

Key Meeting & Milestone Facilitation:
Schedule and co-facilitate (with the Brand Lead) the Full Matrix Team Kick-off Meeting, Walk the Walls Review, and Go-Live Readiness Review.
Drive team preparation and follow-up for each milestone review, including agenda-setting, pre-read materials, and action-item tracking.
Lead post-launch Reconciliation and 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' tactic tracking, capturing actual go-live timing and reporting to the Full Matrix Team.
Lead logistics for Post-Launch Command Center meetings, facilitating agenda development and pre-work status reporting across functions.
Administer the post-launch Launch Review & Survey process, including survey distribution, results consolidation, and reporting to the Full Matrix Team.

Communication & Stakeholder Management:
Execute the launch communication plan, ensuring timely, accurate updates to Core and Matrix Teams at each stage of the launch (kickoff, tactics updates, milestone reviews, regulatory approval, go-live status).
Act as a key liaison between the Brand Lead, Full Matrix Team, and the enterprise Lx Team for support, training, and best-practice guidance.

Success Metrics:
Launch plan and Lx Playbook maintained at a high level of accuracy and currency (weekly updates, no missed critical dates).
On-time execution of key governance meetings (Kick-off, Walk the Walls, Go-Live Readiness) per the recommended timeline.
Minimal gaps or delays identified during Reconciliation and 'In Market' / 'Go-Live' tracking.
Positive feedback from Full Matrix Team via the post-launch Launch Review & Survey.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Life Sciences, Business, Marketing, or related); advanced degree, a plus.
5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical / biotech commercial operations, brand marketing, project management, or launch management.
Demonstrated experience supporting or managing at least one product launch in a matrixed pharma / biotech environment.
Strong project management skills, including experience with cross-functional milestone tracking tools / platforms (e.g., launch playbooks, Smartsheet, MS Project, or equivalent).
Working knowledge of the pharmaceutical promotional review process (MLR / PRC) and standard launch governance practices.
Excellent meeting facilitation, stakeholder management, and written / verbal communication skills.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable driving accountability across functions without direct authority.
Cross-functional collaboration and matrix influence.
Structured project and risk management.
Proactive communication and executive-ready reporting.
Attention to detail balanced with big-picture launch awareness.
Adaptability in a fast-paced, ambiguous, pre-commercial environment.

Familiarity with regulatory and reimbursement milestone tracking (e.g., FDA approval processes, HTA submissions).

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

About The Role

BSI is embarking on a major global Finance Transformation, including the implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning as part of our wider SAP S/4HANA programme.

We are looking for a SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Business Analyst to help bridge the gap between our Finance teams and the technology and implementation teams delivering the programme.

SAC will become a key platform for BSI's FP&A and Commercial Finance teams, supporting budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning. This role will help ensure the solution not only works technically, but is ready for Finance teams to use successfully as it is deployed across BSI.

You will work closely with FP&A, Commercial Finance, regional Finance teams, Deloitte and the wider transformation programme to understand business requirements, support solution design, coordinate testing and data validation, prepare users for deployment and support adoption following go-live.

This is very much a Finance Transformation role rather than a BAU Finance position. You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience of a major global SAC implementation, working across multiple deployment waves and supporting Finance teams through significant process and system change.

Responsibilities

Develop a strong understanding of BSI's new SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solution and how it will support FP&A and Commercial Finance.
Work with Finance stakeholders to gather, challenge, document and validate business and functional requirements.
Help translate Finance requirements into clear functional specifications for Deloitte and technology delivery teams.
Support the design of future-state SAC processes covering budgeting, forecasting, rolling forecasts and long-range planning.
Support the design and validation of SAC planning models, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, approval structures, planning calendars and security requirements.
Help define the readiness and success criteria that must be achieved before SAC is deployed into each country or region.
Support deployment activities across multiple global rollout waves, ensuring Finance teams, processes, data and systems are ready for go-live.
Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including developing test scenarios, scripts and acceptance criteria.
Work directly with Finance users to ensure the system has been thoroughly tested ahead of deployment. System readiness, user testing and training for each deployment were identified as core priorities for the role during the briefing.
Support data mapping, migration, validation and reconciliation between existing and future Finance systems.
Log, track and support the resolution of defects alongside Deloitte and wider programme teams.
Develop training materials, user documentation and work instructions and support end-user training and onboarding.
Support change management and business readiness activities, building relationships with Finance super-users and champions across BSI.
Provide post-go-live hyper-care and help ensure new SAC processes become successfully embedded within the Finance community.
Support the ongoing administration and continuous improvement of SAC following implementation.

At least 5 years' experience within FP&A, Commercial Finance, Finance Transformation, Finance Systems or Business Analysis.
Previous experience working directly with FP&A or Finance Business Partnering teams, with a strong understanding of their processes and requirements. This was identified as particularly important during the hiring-manager briefing.
Good knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, planning and management reporting processes.
Experience documenting business processes and translating Finance requirements into functional requirements or specifications.
Experience supporting a Finance system implementation, transformation or migration programme.
Hands-on SAP Analytics Cloud experience would be highly advantageous; experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAC or a comparable enterprise planning platform will also be considered.
Experience moving from one budgeting or planning system to another would be particularly valuable, as it provides first-hand understanding of the user and change journey involved.
Experience planning and executing UAT, including developing testing scenarios and working with end users.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills with the ability to work across Finance, Technology and implementation teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and the ability to manage multiple workstreams within a complex transformation programme.
Experience with Oracle HFM would be beneficial.
An accountancy qualification such as CIMA, ACA or ACCA, or equivalent, would be advantageous.

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 27-days annual leave, paid sick leave, bank holidays, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, car allowance (dependent on role), income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.
